Here, wikket. You take it. Kah Kah will want to meet new hozen friend.

His camp south at Grookin Hill.

passages.title: Orders are Orders
passages.text:
Hmm.

Mean wikkets fighting with nice wikkets?

Hozen fight mean wikkets too!

passages.title: Friends and Foes
passages.text:
These ookin' Jinyu grookin Kah Kah's nephews!

Wikket once kill many hozen. Now wikket kill many jinyu.

passages.title: Silly Wikket, Slickies are for Hozen
passages.text:
You think hozen crazy, wikket? Wait til you see hozen with no slickies!

Not enough slickies for hozen and wikkets.

Snappers! Hozen hate them ookin' snappers. Wikkets can eat all the snappers!

<Eekle Eekle points to the south.>

passages.title: Silly Wikket, Slickies are for Hozen
passages.text: Wikket grook all them ookin' snappers?

passages.title: Silly Wikket, Slickies are for Hozen
passages.text:
Now everybody got grub! Great hozen wisdom in Eekle Eekle.

Maybe Eekle Eekle become Chieftain someday...

passages.title: The Warren-Mother
passages.text:
We've dealt with the alpha males. Now, the alpha female.

Virmen aren't terribly selective when it comes to breeding, but most broods will still have a dominant mother figure. She's usually bigger, meaner, and tougher than anyone else in the brood.

You know, I wouldn't mind testing my skills against a warren-mother. Mind if I fight alongside you?

passages.title: The Warren-Mother
passages.text:
That should take care of the virmen for a few weeks, at least. Enough time for Mudmug to get out a few good batches of beer, uninterrupted.

And isn't that what's really important?

passages.title: Legacy
passages.text: I'd say we've earned our reward. I can't wait to taste what Mudmug's been brewing.

passages.title: Legacy
passages.text:
I know Uncle Chen's coming back. I'm not worried.

Actually, this is probably my big chance to finally explore Pandaria! No fat uncle tying me down!

passages.title: Green-ish Energy
passages.text:
One word: Methane!

We're going green. Clean burning, high availability, all natural, and will keep the druids off my back when we get back to our neck of the world.

That, and I ran out of blasting powder...

So, I need your help, <name>.

No, no, I wouldn't ask you to do the dirty work - especially not in front of the general. I'll collect these 'deposits' myself.

You gather up some wood for an outhouse - I'm thinking long-term here!

passages.title: Green-ish Energy
passages.text: Gotta watch out for the wet ones...whewee!

passages.title: Green-ish Energy
passages.text: Ah, the smell of progress, and methane.

passages.title: Broken Earthen Figurine
passages.text: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner. However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

passages.title: Broken Earthen Figurine
passages.text: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner. However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

passages.title: The Scouts Return
passages.text:
Hey, while you were out our scouts came back. And get this, they found some Alliance kid.

You should probably go debrief them.

passages.title: The Scouts Return
passages.text: We may have a problem.

passages.title: Stemming the Swarm
passages.text:
I'm not from here. I've never even BEEN here before today. But even I can tell you that something's wrong.

That wall over there was built to keep mantid off of pandaren lands. Now, the mantid are sending their winged scouts over the top, as if the wall wasn't even there!

The only reason those spindly scouts aren't dying is because they're attacking farmers, not soldiers. They wouldn't stand a chance against someone like you.

passages.title: Stemming the Swarm
passages.text: If the flying mantid troops have always been able to fly over, why haven't they before now?

passages.title: Stemming the Swarm
passages.text:
Lin asked you to help us out? Rather presumptive of her.

Still, we are short-manned. We won't turn down your help... or the girl's. You have our thanks, <class>.

passages.title: They Will Be Mist
passages.text:
The mist in this forest is a constant nuisance - one which I'm glad to hand off to trainees like you. Strange creatures lurk in the mist between these trees, and they must constantly be pushed back.

Consider this part of your training.

passages.title: They Will Be Mist
passages.text: Living outside of society has its advantages. I can focus all my energies on training, without being shackled to the societal conventions of modesty, politics, and basic personal hygiene. Here in the woods, I am free to be myself.

passages.title: They Will Be Mist
passages.text: You follow directions well, <name>.

passages.title: Find the Boy
passages.text:
Have you seen my son, Lo? He was here a moment ago and I told him we were leaving today.

I'm sure he's off trying to woo that young Syra Goldendraft. That is the very reason we need to leave!

No son of mine is going to run off with a Goldendraft!

I'm going to search around here for them.

I do keep catching those two sneaking off to the Arboretum. Any chance you could head out there and look for them?

passages.title: Find the Boy
passages.text:
You seek two lovers blind to the ambitions of their family names. They were here, seeking a way to hold to their path.

Sadly they did not find their answers among the trees or art.

passages.title: Shrine of the Dawn
passages.text:
The "children" you seek are not actually children but grown pandaren, despite what their elders might claim. Their love will not be held in check by the feuds of their families.

You will find both Syra and Lo at the Shrine of the Dawn, ever seeking an answer to their dilemma amongst the pandriarchs of old.

passages.title: Shrine of the Dawn
passages.text: Oh stranger! Please tell me you can help us. They really hurt my Lo.

passages.title: The Librarian's Quandary
passages.text:
Lorewalker Stonestep is in charge of the entire temple library. Lately, something has been troubling him and his work.

With thousands of ancient tomes to be transcribed, I can't afford to have him distracted.

Would you follow the path south to the library and see what ails him?

passages.title: The Librarian's Quandary
passages.text:
The Elder Sage Rain-Zhu sent you?

Very well. You shall help me.

passages.title: The Rider's Bind
passages.text:
Have you seen the young serpents in the training yard?

The littles ones tend to be mischievous, and some of them ran off to play before the training session.

The Mistress will get angry if she discovers they're missing.

Would you go find them and bring them back to me? I don't want them to get into trouble.

They like to play out in the open, so look for them in courtyards and around the spires.

passages.title: The Rider's Bind
passages.text: I hope they didn't give you too much trouble.

passages.title: The Rider's Bind
passages.text:
You found them and brought them all back!

They've really taken a liking to you.

Thank you so much!

passages.title: The Jade Serpent
passages.text:
You came to deliver a message to the Jade Serpent, right?

<The little girl tilts her head up at you inquisitively.>

I guess it's time you met her.

passages.title: The Jade Serpent
passages.text: Did you deliver your message?

passages.title: Moth-Ridden
passages.text:
Moths have infested the library. Moths!

Any librarian worth his letters knows that moths are the most dangerous threat to paper, second only to bookworms.

As it turns out, my assistants are a useless bunch of insect-fearing cowards.

Please, you MUST help me get rid of the moths immediately! The works of a thousand pandaren storytellers depend on you!

passages.title: Moth-Ridden
passages.text: I can see the moths eating the pages from here!

passages.title: Moth-Ridden
passages.text: Yes, yes, thank you! You've thinned out their numbers wonderfully.

passages.title: Lighting Up the Sky
passages.text:
Do you like fireworks, <sir/miss>?

I love them! In older times we would set them off to frighten away demons, but I just like them because they're pretty!

I think there are still some old launchers lying around the temple.

Would you go set off some big fireworks for me? It would make me so happy!

passages.title: Lighting Up the Sky
passages.text:
Yay! I saw the fireworks all the way from over here!

Thank you so much, <name>.

passages.title: The Darkness Around Us
passages.text:
Despite our best efforts, the sha broke the seals around the main temple.

If we cannot hold them back here, their darkness will spread to the rest of the Jade Forest.

We need your help immediately. Kill any sha creatures that you see. They should not be difficult to find.

passages.title: The Darkness Around Us
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Every sha slain is another turn in the tide.

passages.title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
passages.text: First, you will need a weapon suited to your talents. Retrieve a staff from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to equip it properly.

passages.title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
passages.text:
A fine weapon. It should suit your needs well.

Now let's put it to use.

passages.title: Out of Sprite
passages.text:
Just to be clear, what happened was an accident. What I did, I did for INDUSTRY!

There was no way I could have known that a sprite invasion would happen at any time, or that one of them would try to eat my new "Pan's Miracle Gro" formula.

Now not only do they have a big sprite leading them, but he's one angry beast.

If I pay you, will you take him out?

passages.title: Out of Sprite
passages.text: Oh why? Why did I have to tamper with the natural order of things? All I wanted was to make these grains grow faster and more numerous.

passages.title: Out of Sprite
passages.text:
Now that that's over I have some ideas on how to make a new concoction. We'll see.

Thank you for your help. Here is your reward.

passages.title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
passages.text: First, you will need a weapon suited to your talents. Retrieve a crossbow from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.

passages.title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
passages.text:
A fine weapon. It should suit your needs well.

Now let's put it to use.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Freshly arrived for your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the strength and cunning to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life working in the fields?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the intellect and force of will necessary to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life scribing in the dusty libraries?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the compassion and the keen eye of a <class>? Or are you destined to a life tending to the livestock?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the awareness and wisdom necessary to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life scribing in the libraries?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the deftness and cunning necessary to be a <class>? Or are you destined to live the life of a humble merchant?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the strength of will to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life of tending to the shrines?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

passages.title: Much to Learn
passages.text:
Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the strength and hardiness to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life working the fields?

Each has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.

Let us begin our training, my newest pupil.

passages.title: Chen's Resolution
passages.text:
You know what? I don't have to take this.

I'll show that Uncle Gao what it means to be a real brewer. I'll brew the best beer he's ever tasted, with ingredients I've never even used before.

I'm Chen Stormstout, and I'm the best brewer alive.

passages.title: Chen's Resolution
passages.text: Let's make some beer.

passages.title: The Chen Taste Test
passages.text:
Uncle Chen is going to love this. Or... he might tell us to find something sweeter. He's kind of dumb like that.

Let's get this grain back to him at Halfhill.

passages.title: The Chen Taste Test
passages.text: Ah! Now these are some beautifully malted grains. The two of you have a good eye and nose.

passages.title: Hop Hunting
passages.text:
With Li Li fetching grain, and Mudmug handling our water, all we need is hops, and some good wood barrels. I'll handle the barrels... but I need you to gather the hops.

I don't know much about the hops from this land, but I'm sure the nearby farmers have something worth brewing with. Go see what you can rustle up.

passages.title: Stormstout's Hops
passages.text: All three farmers have delivered their hops to Halfhill. Perhaps you should check in with Chen to make sure that he received them.

passages.title: Stormstout's Hops
passages.text:
Look at all these hops! This is quality stuff, too.

We're making headway, <name>. Soon we'll have all the ingredients to finally start brewing.

passages.title: The Farmer's Daughter
passages.text:
Brave <class>, you could not have arrived at a better time. My daughter is missing!

I've got a suspicion that the virmen took her down into that stinking little warren of theirs. I'm too old to fight virmen, and my farmhand is already exhausted from fighting them off all morning.

Could you look for her?

passages.title: The Farmer's Daughter
passages.text:
No... no... get back... I don't want...

Wait, you're not a carrot. You're not a virmen either. You're here to save me?

passages.title: Behind the Masks
passages.text:
The sha may seem unstoppable, but this is not true.

Their masks seem to be the source of their power. When a sha and its mask are separated, the creature's essence is banished back to its own realm.

Bring me intact masks, for I wish to study them further. Do be careful. I'm sure the sha will not part with them easily.

passages.title: Behind the Masks
passages.text: Please handle the masks carefully. If you are not careful, they will attempt to consume you.

passages.title: Behind the Masks
passages.text:
I suspect these masks allow the sha to make a physical connection to our world.

I must study them further if we are to banish these creatures forever.

Thank you, <name>. Your aid is greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Saving the Sutras
passages.text:
My adepts had to abandon their studies when the sha invasion began.

Unfortunately, they left their books scattered around the temple grounds. These priceless works of knowledge must be saved!

The sutras can be found near the Training Pit and the Adept's Ring to the northeast.

passages.title: Saving the Sutras
passages.text: How are the sutras? Are they damaged?

passages.title: Saving the Sutras
passages.text: Thank you! What a relief it is to see these texts are safe.

passages.title: Arrows of Fortune
passages.text:
Our war supplies grow low, but especially needed are additional arrows.

Our serpent riders are skilled marksmen, but they can do little without ammunition.

We need someone to brave the battlefields and retrieve any undamaged arrows to refill our stores.

Every arrow you retrieve will be used wisely.

passages.title: Arrows of Fortune
passages.text: Were you able to find any arrows?

passages.title: Arrows of Fortune
passages.text:
These arrows are still in good shape. They will fly straight and true.

Great work, <name>.

passages.title: The Shadow of Doubt
passages.text:
A terrible manifestation of the sha has appeared to the south.

It is trying to destroy an ancient relic, the Bell of a Thousand Whispers.

This bell has never been rung in the temple's history, for it is rumored to be an ancient instrument of power.

Please go and defeat this demon where it stands! We must save this relic!

passages.title: The Shadow of Doubt
passages.text: The bell is said to contain the voices of a thousand fallen temple priests.

passages.title: The Shadow of Doubt
passages.text: You have saved us. From what fate, I dare not imagine.

passages.title: No Plan Survives Contact with the Enemy
passages.text:
Quickly and quietly; that's how SI:7 prefers to operate. That was the plan, at least.

Rell Nightwind is already inside Garrosh'ar Point looking for signs of Anduin and Taylor, but it's getting hot in there and he needs support.

Fight yer way through these dogs and find Rell!

passages.title: No Plan Survives Contact with the Enemy
passages.text: This place is crawling with Horde soldiers - we can't advance on their leader with so many at our backs.

passages.title: No Plan Survives Contact with the Enemy
passages.text: Great work! If you ever decide to give up your life of adventure, the SI:7 could use more talent like you...

passages.title: The Emperor
passages.text:
We have everything we need. It's time to start brewing.

Pay attention, <name>... you might learn a thing or two.

passages.title: The Emperor
passages.text: It takes more than three seconds to make beer, <name>. Even when your name is Chen Stormstout.

passages.title: The Emperor
passages.text: Thanks for waiting so long. You are as patient as you are brave.

passages.title: The Fanciest Water
passages.text:
I've heard lots of cockamamie rumors about this here brewery. I thought they were all false... until I saw that giant hozen.

So, it got me thinkin', what if the other rumors are true? I heard this one rumor just the other day about some water sprites that run around inside the brewery, causin' a ruckus and whatnot. Their bodies are actually MADE OF WATER.

I reckon a man could make some mighty fine beer with some fancy water like that. If you find any, could you bring me some?

passages.title: The Fanciest Water
passages.text: This is gonna be great. It'll be just like makin' beer, but instead of water, I'm gonna use water sprite meat.

passages.title: The Fanciest Water
passages.text:
Looks like plain ol' water to me. It's hard to believe it's actually the corpse of a real, honest-to-goodness walkin'-around living thing.

Can't wait to turn it into beer and drink it.

passages.title: Barrels, Man
passages.text:
I can't believe that giant hozen! He's just throwing barrels everywhere!

Barrels, man!

It looks like he managed to get pretty much all the pandaren that were working out in front of the brewery. If I were you, I'd help some of them break out. Put some of those ridiculous muscles to use.

We're headed over to the brewery's rear entrance, to the east. Meet you there!

passages.title: Barrels, Man
passages.text: What is it with monkeys and barrels, anyway?

passages.title: Finding Yi-Mo
passages.text:
My nephew, Yi-Mo, has always been sort of a downer. When this wave of despair hit the town, he took it harder than most. He sat around for days refusing to eat, just staring off into the horizon.

Now he's wandered off toward the cliffs northeast of here, where the thunderbirds nest and hunt.

Please, <class>, will you look for him?

passages.title: Finding Yi-Mo
passages.text: <Yi-Mo lets out a long sigh.>

passages.title: Finding Yi-Mo
passages.text: Let me guess: my aunt sent you?

passages.title: The Search for the Hidden Master
passages.text:
Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs.

I'm just a visitor... like you.

Now if you'll excuse me, my friends and I are trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

passages.title: The Search for the Hidden Master
passages.text:
Were you listening in? Don't worry, I don't mind. You're welcome to search for the hidden master as well.

Though, if you do find him, I'd appreciate if you came back here and told me where he was.

passages.title: FLAG - Kung Fu Intro
passages.text:
Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.

Now if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

passages.title: Tears of Pandaria
passages.text:
All of this started with our ponds. In a single day, all of the water retreated down into the earth. When there was no more water in the ponds, it began to fall from the sky.

Despite endless torrents of rain, the ponds do not fill. It's as if the land itself thirsts and cannot be quenched.

Now the ponds birth horrific manifestations of despair. Elementals made of water from the sky and salt from the earth; the tears of Pandaria.

passages.title: Tears of Pandaria
passages.text: I don't know why this is happening, but I can say for certain that those elementals were the start of it all.

passages.title: Tears of Pandaria
passages.text:
Thank you, <class>.

It's time we take back our land from this curse.

passages.title: Search Party
passages.text:
I sent a diplomat to look for allies in the ruins east of here.

My diplomat has not returned and now Kang tells me this jungle is filled with a sinister people known as the mogu.

Chezin is my friend and Leza's brother. To lose a brother would cause her to give in to despair. She already has enough to worry about with her fever.

Could you investigate the ruins east of here and find out what happened?

passages.title: Search Party
passages.text: P... poison. Need... warn... Dezco...

passages.title: Skitterer Stew
passages.text:
Leza has a fever. No mother in labor should have a fever.

Mama Bramblestaff once told me that Skitterer Stew could heal almost any illness. Let us put this knowledge to the test.

Gather some intact skitterer glands for me while I get the herbs we'll need and I'll whip up a batch.

passages.title: Skitterer Stew
passages.text: Even the jungle air is alive with danger.

passages.title: Skitterer Stew
passages.text:
Excellent! Nothing clears a sickness like Skitterer Stew.

Here, take this. It's a little memento of Mama Bramblestaff.

passages.title: Blind Them!
passages.text:
These sunwalkers are a tiresome lot. I need soldiers with horde blood in their veins and honor in their hearts. Not some pacifist sun spirit filth.

The Alliance are here, adventurer. Followed us no doubt, or somehow tracked the same visions Leza had that led us here. It doesn't matter. I don't want them to know how divided we are at the moment. Go kill their scout south of here before it can report back.

Hellscream's eyes upon you.

passages.title: Blind Them!
passages.text: Well done, <name>. You have performed admirably and bought us some time to fortify our defenses. Now if I can just get Dezco to go on the offensive.

passages.title: Crane Mastery
passages.text:
Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.

Can't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.

Can I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.

passages.title: The Mogu Agenda
passages.text:
Mogu don't often gather in numbers like this. We should find out what they are up to.

I thought I heard someone shouting orders near the center of the ruins.

We should probably see if he has information.

passages.title: The Mogu Agenda
passages.text:
The mogu once ruled as emperors, subjugating all races they encountered.

It would seem these particular mogu have aspirations of reliving the past.

passages.title: The Mogu Agenda
passages.text:
Wait. This document talks about the Pools of Youth!

The pools exist?!

passages.title: Life
passages.text:
My child is coming. I must help as I may.

Stay nearby, hero. If my wife and child survive, I would have them look on the face of the one who saved them.

passages.title: Life
passages.text: I pray to An'she that my wife and child survive this journey.

passages.title: Life
passages.text:
She... she died. For all the powers the Light has given me, I was unable to save her.

Thanks to your help, however... we saved my sons.

passages.title: It's A...
passages.text:
Oh my! This egg is going to hatch at any second!

Well, looks like this little guy is eager to meet you.

Are you ready?

passages.title: It's A...
passages.text: What a proud moment for you!

passages.title: It's A...
passages.text:
Congratulations! It's a beautiful hatchling of your own.

Please take care of it, <name>.

passages.title: They Grow Like Weeds
passages.text:
Ahh, it is you again, <name>.

Instructor Windblade is looking for you. You can find her on the ridge to the east.

She has some news about your cloud serpent.

passages.title: They Grow Like Weeds
passages.text: You are doing well, trainee.

passages.title: They Grow Like Weeds
passages.text:
Congratulations, <name>.

There is great joy in seeing the fruits of your own labor.

passages.title: Flight Training: Full Speed Ahead
passages.text:
The next task will be a little harder.

Are you ready?

passages.title: Flight Training: Full Speed Ahead
passages.text: I hope I do not need to question your dedication.

passages.title: Flight Training: Full Speed Ahead
passages.text: You did better than I expected. Not bad for a new trainee.

passages.title: A Feast for the Senses
passages.text:
I have heard that you know a thing or two about cooking.

As it so happens, serpents love to eat Fish Cakes.

If you use your culinary skills and bring me 5 of these dishes, the cloud serpents around here will be very happy.

passages.title: A Feast for the Senses
passages.text: Were you able to find the necessary ingredients?

passages.title: A Feast for the Senses
passages.text: Oh these do look quite delicious. You are quite the cook!

passages.title: Full Speed Ahead
passages.text:
It is time for our training session.

Follow me around the spires. Let's see if you can keep up while staying mounted.

passages.title: The Easiest Way To A Serpent's Heart
passages.text:
<The hatchling scowls at you.>

Uh-oh, looks like someone is in a bad mood today!

Luckily, you know just the thing that will cheer up the little beast.

Cloud serpents love the taste of tiger meat, but the tender flanks can be... challenging... to acquire.

Luckily, you recall there are some fat, juicy tigers to the northeast, on Windward Isle.

Sure, you might suffer some scratches and a little mauling, but it's all worth it for your serpent, right?

passages.title: The Easiest Way To A Serpent's Heart
passages.text: Looks like the task is done.

passages.title: The Easiest Way To A Serpent's Heart
passages.text: I see you have been hard at work, gathering food for your hungry little serpent. Well done. It may not seem worth it now, but your serpent will know of your efforts, and it will love you for it.

passages.title: For the Tribe
passages.text:
We fell back to the refuge when the mogu attacked but lost a number of our people along the way.

Travel west and north of here and look for any captives you can rescue that could help us in our fight.

Leave any Alliance you find to their fate.

passages.title: For the Tribe
passages.text: Hellscream's eyes upon you.

passages.title: For the Tribe
passages.text: We've already lost so many. I refuse to lose any more.

passages.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
passages.text:
I tried to save as many of the Stoneplow envoys as I could but these "mantid" dragged many of them off into the jungle.

These are civilians in need of our help.

Please take the herbs you gathered earlier. I've infused them with what gifts of the Light are still granted me. Use them on as many of the Stoneplow envoys as you can.

passages.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
passages.text: A sunwalker's first duty is to preserve and protect life.

passages.title: The Stoneplow Convoy
passages.text:
The civilians are trickling in thanks to you. These "mantid" creatures are a serious threat. We will need to rally our forces soon to help.

One of the envoys asked me to give this to you as a token of thanks.

passages.title: Raid Leader Slovan
passages.text:
The raiders are led by a particularly violent saurok known as Slovan. The Crane Temple usually comes to our aid when he attacks but now we find ourselves outmatched and outmaneuvered.

Please, <class>, aid us by destroying this raid leader.

You can find him in his den behind the Krasari Falls.

passages.title: Raid Leader Slovan
passages.text: Slovan has always been a nuisance, but with the Crane Temple's defenses down he has become a true threat.

passages.title: Raid Leader Slovan
passages.text:
You have done us a great service today. On behalf of my people I thank you.

Please, accept this token of our gratitude.

passages.title: Labor for Labor
passages.text:
My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood.

Could you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!

passages.title: Mushan Mastery
passages.text:
Mushan! Would ya look at the size o' 'em. Old as the dirt they walk on probably. A fine trophy.

If you are lookin' to test your mettle as a big game hunter, start with them.

passages.title: Mushan Mastery
passages.text: They didn't send ya' runin' did they?

passages.title: Mushan Mastery
passages.text:
Well done <name>.

My father travels across the sea to a new continent and all he can seem ta' want to hunt is old borin' wolves.

Me, I like to hunt stuff with meat on its bones.

passages.title: Fox Mastery
passages.text:
So, when I was scouting east of here I saw a collection of foxes. That's what I first learned to hunt when back on the Wandering Isle.

If you want to see the challenge a young pandaren hunter faced when growing up, head east and face off against a bunch of foxes. They tend to be clever and cunning so be on your guard.

passages.title: Fox Mastery
passages.text: I used to go on fox hunts with my father. If he could see me now! Hunting in Pandaria!

passages.title: Fox Mastery
passages.text: Well done! You outfoxed the foxes. I will talk to Mr. Pleeb about getting you another trophy made.

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text:
I can no longer call myself your teacher, <name>.

You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent.

Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text: Today, we become brethren. Congratulations on joining the Order of the Cloud Serpent. Let us ride together!

passages.title: Sprite Plight
passages.text:
Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!

If you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

passages.title: Sprite Plight
passages.text:
We need to figure out where these things are coming from. We're dealing with this near daily and it's getting out of hand.

Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
passages.text:
Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find.

Bring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.

passages.title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
passages.text: Did you find any of the stolen kegs?

passages.title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
passages.text: The workers will love you for this!

passages.title: My Town, It's on Fire
passages.text:
I don't know if you noticed, but my town is burning...

The sprites have started kicking the braziers! They're going to set fire to the whole town!

Please help us! Stamp out any fires you see!

passages.title: My Town, It's on Fire
passages.text:
I really wish you guys would stop throwing the buckets at the fire too� just the water would have been fine.

Really though, it's a relief that you're here to help. Thank you.

passages.title: Meating Expectations
passages.text:
Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!

Can you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

passages.title: Meating Expectations
passages.text: No shortage of mouths to feed, that's for sure!

passages.title: Meating Expectations
passages.text: Doesn't get much fresher! Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Encroaching Storm
passages.text:
The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold.

This is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again.

If you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.

passages.title: Encroaching Storm
passages.text: Your act is one of a responsible hunter. I respect you for it.

passages.title: Blooming Blossoms
passages.text:
Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.

Could you help me out, perhaps?

passages.title: Blooming Blossoms
passages.text: Was your flower-gathering bountiful?

passages.title: Blooming Blossoms
passages.text:
Aha! You are quite the kind patron.

Thank you... thank you.

passages.title: Lushroom Rush
passages.text:
Building a new village makes for hungry workers it seems!

I have a hearty stew recipe prepared, but I need some lushrooms from the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east. Apparently there are roused spirits causing trouble up there though, and I'm not very well suited for the violent life.

If you're heading up the burial grounds today, could you collect some lushrooms for me?

passages.title: Lushroom Rush
passages.text: I can hear the hungry bellies rumbling throughout the village!

passages.title: Lushroom Rush
passages.text:
Good timing! The stew's almost ready.

You have my thanks.

passages.title: Cart Ride
passages.text: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

passages.title: In Ashen Webs
passages.text:
We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.

Care to put things back in control?

passages.title: In Ashen Webs
passages.text: You're quicker than the trainees, but I would have been disappointed if you weren't. Thanks.

passages.title: Runelocked
passages.text:
Hello, friend.

One of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.

If you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

passages.title: Runelocked
passages.text: Did you find the runes I was telling you about?

passages.title: Runelocked
passages.text: This is marvelous... very well perserved. Thank you very much, friend! I owe you for this.

passages.title: Runes in the Ruins
passages.text:
In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.

If you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

passages.title: Runes in the Ruins
passages.text: These runestones were used as sources of power long ago, when the mogu still ruled the vale.

passages.title: Runes in the Ruins
passages.text: These are lovely! Thank you, kind <class>.

passages.title: The Ashweb Matriarch
passages.text:
My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.

I need you to kill it.

passages.title: The Ashweb Matriarch
passages.text: You've got a follow-through I can respect, <class>. Thanks.

passages.title: Blood on the Rise
passages.text:
A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.

Extinguish them.

passages.title: Blood on the Rise
passages.text: As it should be. Thank you.

passages.title: Wulon, the Granite Sentinel
passages.text:
One of the quilen statues in Guo-Lai Halls came to life and nearly killed my precious Kun. I won't have it! No one threatens my Kun.

I want you to go in there and smash the thing to pieces. I'd do it myself, but I need to attend to my lover's wounds first.

passages.title: Wulon, the Granite Sentinel
passages.text: Thanks. I owe you one, <class>.

passages.title: Troubling the Troublemakers
passages.text: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

passages.title: Troubling the Troublemakers
passages.text: Some peace and quiet. Thank you.

passages.title: The Greater Danger
passages.text:
I apologize for my harsh words earlier. Dezco might have been right to wait and move west with a unified strength.

The mogu hit us hard when we were searching the ruins west of here. They ambushed us using summoning portals and some dark magics. I haven't seen such evil sorcery used since Outland. 

We need a respite. Head west, kill their summoners, cut their supply line.

passages.title: The Greater Danger
passages.text: Did you break their reinforcements?

passages.title: The Greater Danger
passages.text: With their reinforcements severed we can begin to mount an offensive against their Lord Reclaimer.

passages.title: Pomfruit Pickup
passages.text:
I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?

Take this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

passages.title: Pomfruit Pickup
passages.text: I always misjudge how much juice I can get out of these things.

passages.title: Pomfruit Pickup
passages.text: Delicious! I am indebted to you, my friend.

passages.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
passages.text:
The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.

If you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

passages.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
passages.text: I hesitate to continually ask such menial things of one so accomplished as you, but we are in desperate times.

passages.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
passages.text: You have my most gracious thanks, young one.

passages.title: Cracklefang
passages.text:
Hi! So, I have a dilemma. I've only got one good wolf name.... wait for it... Cracklefang! I know, amazing right?! But now there are TWO big nasty wolves in the forest, which is all kinds of confusing.

I need you to kill one of them so I can free up the name. Should be simple enough, yeah? Especially for someone of your incredibleness.

So, are you on board? I'm hoping for yes!

passages.title: Cracklefang
passages.text:
Yes! Only one Cracklefang remains to terrorize the goats and yaks of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. As it should be! Thank you for that!

I sure hope no more big nasty wolves turn up. I really don't think I'm going to be able to come up with another name that can live up to that one.

passages.title: Vicejaw
passages.text:
Vicejaw! Sounds absolutely violent, does it not? I came up with it myself, and I think it's very suiting. I tried to wrestle my staff away from him for hours, but he simply would not let go!

Okay, it was really more like a few seconds. I like to be truthful to my friends, even if it makes my stories significantly more boring.

Anyway, would you be so kind as to release your oh-so-potent wrath upon this crocolisk with a vice-like jaw, and then kindly bring my staff back? Preferably in-tact!

passages.title: Vicejaw
passages.text:
My staff! My gorgeous staff! We shall never part again. I shall lean on you, and you will always be there. And I promise not to poke crocodiles with you anymore.

Thank you, friend. Your staff retrieval skills have proved invaluable today!

passages.title: Quid Pro Quo
passages.text:
Quid is a very powerful and very ancient water spirit, though you might not know it with his child-like ways.

This morning, Quid nearly killed several villagers in the bar when he jokingly caused several of the water kegs to explode.

As long as the water flows, Quid will remain. He cannot be slain. But he can be reminded that we do not take his dangerous antics in jest.

Would you be willing to carry this message to him on behalf of the village?

passages.title: Quid Pro Quo
passages.text:
For the sake of the villagers, I hope he remains at bay for some time.

Thank you, my friend.

passages.title: Aetha
passages.text:
It seems Aetha has been levitating the livestock and dropping them into the river again. The mayor has requested that we remind her that these kinds of jokes are not welcomed.

Would you be so generous as to travel to the ridge above the village and teach her this lesson? You cannot kill her, you can only send her away for a time, but this should prove a potent reminder.

passages.title: Aetha
passages.text: The spirits may be childlike, but they possess generous mounts of strength for their size. Your victory is no small thing, and is very appreciated.

passages.title: The Pandaren Uprising Relived
passages.text:
In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley.

If you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.

passages.title: The Pandaren Uprising Relived
passages.text: The spirits of the pandaren monks seem invigorated by the deaths of their mogu oppressors.  It is a small victory, but it shows respect to great heroes of the past.

passages.title: Return to Rest
passages.text:
The spirits of our ancestors are reliving one of the most revered battles in our history at the Tu Shen Burial Grounds to the east.

Do as I ask, <race>, and honor their gravestones. Remind them that they are respected even these many years later, and that they are deserving of peaceful rest.

passages.title: Return to Rest
passages.text: Thank you, my friend. You respect for our ancestors means a great deal.

passages.title: Lao-Fe the Slavebinder
passages.text:
You can hear the spirit of Lao-Fe, the Slavebinder shouting taunts from the cave at the top of Tu Shen Burial Mound.

Defeating him will surely serve to ensure victory for the spirits of the pandaren monks.

passages.title: Lao-Fe the Slavebinder
passages.text:
Lao-Fe the Slavebinder was one of the most spiteful and vicious mogu of his time. May defeating his spirit act as a reminder to all the mogu in the vale of the fate that awaits them if they seek to defile the sacred pools again.

Your strength is unquestionable. You have my respect, <class>.

passages.title: Lost Scouts
passages.text:
We sent some scouts towards the Five Sisters to the north to try and find whatever mogu leader has risen up to direct their movements in the valley. Few have returned.

I'd like to think they're just off downing too much ale or being irresponsible with some young pandaren, but they may actually be in some trouble.

Can you scout for the scouts? And see if they've turned up any information on that leader while you're at it?

passages.title: Lost Scouts
passages.text: The scout reports have pinpointed the mogu leader's position.

passages.title: The Butcher
passages.text:
Scouts reports place the displaced Shao-Tien Imperion at the north end of the wall.

Angi Autumnlight spelled out your goal in no uncertain terms: find this leader and kill him.

passages.title: The Butcher
passages.text: Look at you! All proactive and assertive. Looks good on you.

passages.title: Under the Setting Sun
passages.text: A giant beast has burrowed under the gate into the courtyard. The defenders need your help!

passages.title: Under the Setting Sun
passages.text: I heard you performed some heroics in the courtyard! Your name will be remembered on the wall for some time. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord
passages.text: A giant mantid is terrorizing the inside of the wall. It seems doubtful that the defenders will be able deal with it without you.

passages.title: Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord
passages.text: I like your initiative. Good work.

passages.title: A Helping Hand
passages.text:
I've been pushing and shoving and hammering all morning, but it's hopeless.

These rocks won't budge!

"It will be a breeze," Grandpa said. "Farming's like breathing!" he said. Maybe for him, but not for me!

How am I supposed to succeed at this whole FARMING thing if I can't even clear my farm for planting?

Hey, wait a minute. You look like you've got some muscle on you.

Would you be willing to help me out? Just until I can catch my breath.

passages.title: A Helping Hand
passages.text: I really wasn't cut out for this type of work. I didn't exactly grow up in the country.

passages.title: A Helping Hand
passages.text:
What? You cleared the rocks? That's great news!

Maybe now I can actually start growing something on this farm!

passages.title: The Family Farm
passages.text:
D-did you hear what they said?

It's almost like they don't want me here. Like...I'm not good enough.

Sure I've never run a farm before, but I know how to plant a seed and how to pick a turnip.

<Farmer Yoon's eyes light up.>

You know what? I'm going to show them that I can also become a master farmer!

I'm going to turn this farm into one of the most prosperous in the Valley!

It's too much work for one pandaren, though. Come on! Will you help me?

passages.title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine
passages.text:
Get to the bottom of the wall in the fastest time possible.

Speak to me when you're ready to roll.

passages.title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine
passages.text: Ready to roll?

passages.title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine
passages.text: When they built the wall, I don't think they knew we'd be using it for this.

passages.title: Clearing in the Forest
passages.text:
The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.

Take the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

passages.title: Clearing in the Forest
passages.text:
We must seize our advantage when an opportunity presents itself. We must make the Shao-Tien pay for every moment they remain in the Vale.

You've done well this day, <class>.

passages.title: Sparkle in the Eye
passages.text:
I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.

Would you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

passages.title: Sparkle in the Eye
passages.text: What were these mysterious sparkles? I've been dying with curiosity. Coins? Goblets? A dozen discarded wedding rings?

passages.title: Sparkle in the Eye
passages.text:
Rubies! Valuable, yes! Suggestive of an interesting backstory involving a dozen broken-hearted brides? Likely not. Still, quite the find!

Thank you my marvelously benevolent friend! You have saved me some awkwardly wet robes with your generous aquatic ways.

passages.title: Striking the Rain
passages.text:
Now as for that "striking the rain" part... well, sometimes you have to.

"Hope is the sun behind a stormy sky - ever in the heart, but veiled to the eye."

There seems to be no end to the sha pouring out of the temple. But in order to see beyond the veil of despair, you must carve through it.

With any luck, you'll find a sun behind the clouds...

passages.title: Striking the Rain
passages.text: We shouldn't press further into the temple before clearing out some of the sha presence outside.

passages.title: Striking the Rain
passages.text: You know something, <name>? We make a pretty good team!

passages.title: The Arcanic Oubliette
passages.text:
An Alliance member? Here? Elune be praised.

My team has encountered a snag. We opened a portal to this land using some ancient scrolls we had found that predated Azshara's rule.

Unfortunately, the coordinates provided on the tablets were warded and the portal that meant to take us to our destination landed us in this oubliette.

We have been trapped here for days, and it is slowly leaching our energies to power itself.

Can you find the nearby shackles that bind the oubliette and disable them?

passages.title: The Arcanic Oubliette
passages.text:
Fabulous! Your timing was impeccable. Another day in there and I think we would have wasted away to nothing.

Now we can continue our search for the Pools of Youth!

passages.title: The Thunder Below
passages.text:
Roars have been echoing out from inside the Guo-Lai Halls. The mogu have awakened some ancient beast, and it will not be long before they attempt to release it upon my men.

Find your way to the Hall of the Serpent and slay the beast before it can be unleashed upon us. I would trust no other with such a dangerous and important task.

passages.title: The Thunder Below
passages.text: Have you slain the beast?

passages.title: The Thunder Below
passages.text: You accomplish what I doubt I could even overcome myself. I am humbled by your valor.

passages.title: The Silent Approach
passages.text: <He leans over and draws a picture of what can only be a mogu, points towards the lake to the west, drags the blunt side of his dagger across his throat, and looks at you expectantly. It seems he wants you to kill mogu at Whitepetal Lake.>

passages.title: The Silent Approach
passages.text: The mogu numbers seem to be sufficiently thinned.

passages.title: Burning Away the Filth
passages.text: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

passages.title: Burning Away the Filth
passages.text: I'll take the smoke on the horizon to mean that they've received our message. Good.

passages.title: A Smashing Impression
passages.text:
Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from?

Or we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.

passages.title: A Smashing Impression
passages.text:
If they come asking who rudely crushed all their little statuettes, I'll tell them it was you.

Not that I don't appreciate your help. You're lovely.

passages.title: A Thousand Pointy Teeth
passages.text:
The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip!

You are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim?

It's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!

passages.title: A Thousand Pointy Teeth
passages.text:
Aren't you just the sweetest thing?! I do rather like you.

I'm going to take that afore-mentioned dip now. I'll be modest and delay my disrobing until you depart, as a repayment for your kindness.

...you're missing quite the sight though, I must say.

passages.title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
passages.text:
There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well.

If you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.

passages.title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
passages.text: Any luck finding those reports?  I'm worried for the safety of our men in the field if too much information falls into mogu hands.

passages.title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
passages.text: You are very kind, <name>. Thank you for putting my mind at ease.

passages.title: Backed Into a Corner
passages.text:
Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them.

Go quickly friend, save as many as you can!

passages.title: Backed Into a Corner
passages.text:
We've holed up everyone we can in the bar. We should be able to protect them for now.

Thank you again for your help, <name>. You always seem to be there right when we need you.

passages.title: My Town, It's On Fire Again
passages.text:
I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again.

We have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!

passages.title: My Town, It's On Fire Again
passages.text: We owe you so much... thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Stonebound Killers
passages.text:
Mogu stone dog creatures chasing villagers and hurting them. Rook try to smash some, but they too fast.

You help smash some too?

passages.title: Stonebound Killers
passages.text:
Yes! You faster than rook. Do good!

Thank you, friend.

passages.title: Stunning Display
passages.text:
I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.

Would you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

passages.title: Stunning Display
passages.text: As an added bonus, my method ensures they're already cooked! If that's not a marvel of modern efficiency, I don't know what is.

passages.title: Stunning Display
passages.text:
Marvelous! You're quite the efficient fetcher.

I'm grateful that you don't mind getting that fancy armor of yours wet.

passages.title: Rude Awakenings
passages.text:
The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully.

Anyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such.

Can you go kill some saurok for me?

passages.title: Rude Awakenings
passages.text:
You smell of saurok and mogu. Not a terribly pleasant mix, my friend. But it suggests to me that your task is done, and for that I thank you.

May we meet again soon under better-smelling terms.

passages.title: Gaohun the Soul-Severer
passages.text:
Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure!

You been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?

passages.title: Gaohun the Soul-Severer
passages.text: Leader gone. People safe. Rook save village. And friend save village too. Thank you, friend!

passages.title: Baolai the Immolator
passages.text:
Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure!

You been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?

passages.title: Baolai the Immolator
passages.text: Leader gone. People safe. Rook save village. And friend save village too. Thank you, friend!

passages.title: Painting the Ruins Red
passages.text: The mogu think they can inhabit these ruins uncontested. Let's show them the error in their ways.

passages.title: Painting the Ruins Red
passages.text: Their foothold in these ruins shall not last the night.

passages.title: No Stone Unturned
passages.text:
The mogu have forced spirits into their old statues to bring them to life, control them, and turn them against us.

The only way to free the bound spirits is to destroy their vessels.

passages.title: No Stone Unturned
passages.text: Your efforts here make all the difference. Thank you so much for your help, friend.

passages.title: Offering a Warm Welcome
passages.text:
There is no more sure message we can send them then to burn the tents the sleep in.

Scour the ruins. Destroy every tent you find.

passages.title: Offering a Warm Welcome
passages.text: Smoke in the distance tells me that you were successful. Good work, <class>.

passages.title: The Imperion Threat
passages.text:
Scouts spotted a Shao-Tien Imperion entering the Guo-Lai Halls. I need someone I can trust to make sure he doesn't come out of there alive.

I think you're the <class> for the job.

passages.title: The Imperion Threat
passages.text: You haven't let me down.  I won't forget that.

passages.title: Hard as a Rock
passages.text:
Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning?

I was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me!

Anji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.

passages.title: Hard as a Rock
passages.text: Your ruins vandalizing efforts are appreciated, friend.

passages.title: He Knows What He's Doing
passages.text:
You know He Softfoot? Sneaky guy, don't talk much. He put traps all over ruins for mogu. He said Rook just need to trick mogu into traps. Rook don't really know how.

Maybe you do it? You find traps, you get bad guys into traps? Can you not tell He though, please?

passages.title: He Knows What He's Doing
passages.text: You really good friend. Rook like you. Thank you, good friend!

passages.title: The Eternal Vigil
passages.text:
Good to have you with us, <class>. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.

Can I count on you?

passages.title: The Eternal Vigil
passages.text: We hold this line. It does not matter how long they come, we hold this line.

passages.title: Stone Hard Quilen
passages.text: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?

passages.title: Stone Hard Quilen
passages.text: Less of those beasts on the field always cheers my day up a bit. Thanks.

passages.title: Set in Stone
passages.text:
The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair.

The bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?

passages.title: Set in Stone
passages.text: There's a satisfying amount of ruble strewn across the field today. A sign of your good work.

passages.title: Thundering Skies
passages.text:
The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us.

The defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.

passages.title: Thundering Skies
passages.text: Quite the battle! I think your feat has boosted morale among the troops a bit.

passages.title: High Standards
passages.text:
If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.

If some unknown <class> were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

passages.title: Given a Second Chance
passages.text:
A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.

Here are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.

Please hurry, there is little time.

passages.title: Given a Second Chance
passages.text:
The men you healed made it back safely.

Thank you, kind friend. Truly.

passages.title: The Moving Mists
passages.text: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>

passages.title: The Moving Mists
passages.text: <He pats you on the shoulder and nods his thanks.>

passages.title: The Displaced Paleblade
passages.text: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>

passages.title: The Displaced Paleblade
passages.text: <He smiles at you and nods his thanks.>

passages.title: Normal Quest Test Case
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Longshot
passages.text: I would not normally ask this of grizzle <class> such as you, but since you are to be on the battlefield below the Golden Stair anyway, would you recover spent arrows for the archers?

passages.title: Cindergut Peppers
passages.text:
A certain few pandaren around here prefer their dishes unbearably spicy. Unfortunately, my access to such peppers is limited.

The Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, often carry cindergut peppers. A few of those and I'll be set for a few days.

Say, could you collect some for me? You might want to wear gloves if you'll be handling them directly.

passages.title: Cindergut Peppers
passages.text: Just put the peppers down on the cutting board, here. I'd prefer not to touch them myself.

passages.title: Cindergut Peppers
passages.text: I don't know how the hozen manage to carry these things on their bodies... let alone eat the things.

passages.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
passages.text:
Like any farming community, we have the occasional virmen troubles.

The most powerful Springtail virmen live high up in the cliffs to the north, and only come down when they run out of veggies to nibble on.

Frankly, I've dealt with virmen before. They're nothing but a pest that must be kept in check, and there's no better way to do that than by killing their warren-mother. Easy as that.

passages.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
passages.text: I've had plenty of experience with virmen in the past. Just show them you're stronger than they are, and they'll back off.

passages.title: The Lesser of Two Evils
passages.text: There, that's done with. Now we shift our focus back to farming, for a change.

passages.title: Stalling the Ravage
passages.text:
The Kunzen hozen, up in the mountains to the west, have been acting up, lighting their fires and shouting their chants. Based on what I've heard and seen around here, that means that a ravage is coming.

There's not much we can do to stop the ravage, but we can at least thin their numbers before they attack.

passages.title: Stalling the Ravage
passages.text: The ravage could come any time now. We have to be prepared.

passages.title: Stalling the Ravage
passages.text:
They'll be attacking, but my farm - and the farms of my friends - should not be in any danger.

Not if we can help it, anyways. Right, <name>?

passages.title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
passages.text:
From what I've gathered, the Kunzen hozen have two chiefs. One is harmless - he deals with potions, medicines, and ancient fables. The other one is in charge of the Kunzen's hunters - and the only thing they've been hunting lately is our crops.

The Hunter-Chief is a problem waiting to be solved. I'm sure the local farmers would be grateful if you went up there and, you know, "took care" of him.

passages.title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
passages.text: Mm-hmm.

passages.title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
passages.text:
No doubt the hozen will have a big ritual tonight, promoting a new Hunter-Chief.

I'm just happy that my fellow farmers can rest easy in the meantime.

passages.title: A Weighty Task
passages.text:
For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.

Ah well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...

Would you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

passages.title: A Weighty Task
passages.text: Have you find a pretty stone thing or two for me? I have a hug waiting for you should you have been so kind!

passages.title: A Weighty Task
passages.text:
Well look at you! Not only can you swim in all that very ornate and heavy-looking gear, you can carry half-a-dozen awkwardly large gilded weapons while you do it! Of all your feats, this is surely one of the most impressive, no?

Thank you, you marvelously adept swimmer you.

passages.title: Getting your Hands Dirty
passages.text:
Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait.

Who can really remember such things?

If you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. 

How's that sound?

passages.title: Getting your Hands Dirty
passages.text: So much fishin' in store! I can hardly wait to start my waitin'.

passages.title: Getting your Hands Dirty
passages.text: I like a <race> who isn't too lofty to help a humble merchant out. Thank you.

passages.title: Stick in the Mud
passages.text:
I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.

Those reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. 

How's that sound?

passages.title: Stick in the Mud
passages.text: So much fishin' in store! I can hardly wait to start my waitin'.

passages.title: Stick in the Mud
passages.text: I like a <race> who isn't too lofty to help a humble merchant out. Thank you.

passages.title: Under Watchful Eyes
passages.text: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>

passages.title: Under Watchful Eyes
passages.text: <He bows thankfully.>

passages.title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
passages.text:
I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.

Would you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

passages.title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
passages.text:
Do you hear that, my beautiful feet? You can rest easy now, your water-kicking days have returned!

You've been oh so lovely, friend. Do share the fruits of your labors and spend a second or two by the water with me someday. We can exchange tales of that one time when you so generously slaughtered a ravaging band of vicious limb-snatching reptiles for the sake of my frightened and innocent feet. What a grand day that was.

passages.title: To the Waterline!
Poisoned!
passages.text: Poison... I... I can feel it... burning. Please, adventurer... grab... grab some of the mogu swords. We need... need poison samples. For an... ant... antidote.

passages.title: Where are the Pools
passages.text:
Perhaps these mogu know where the pools are.

Our scouts have reported seeing a commander along the southern side of the Ruins of Dojan.

Kill him and take whatever information he is carrying. They should lead you to the pool.

passages.title: Where are the Pools
passages.text:
<You sense the presence of Lorekeeper Vaeldrin, then hear his voice within your mind.>

Hmm. I'm still not sure about these references to "torture" regarding the Pools of Youth.

passages.title: Where are the Pools
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. Hmm, it looks like the mogu are here to collect ancient relics and weapons from their forgotten dynasty. That is a problem we can face later though.

Ah! Here is a reference to the Pools of Youth.

passages.title: Immortality?
passages.text:
Something is... off. The water feels strange.

When we arrived here I felt the presence of the Light, strong and vibrant, far to the north.

I thought it would be the Pools of Youth. But this... this water is tainted somehow. Stained with mogu magics.

I think it best I try only a sip and we see what happens.

passages.title: Immortality?
passages.text: Wha... what happened? The water... it... it only transfers life. It will not make new life.

passages.title: Squirmy Delight
passages.text:
The hidden master may have to wait. Look at these people, adventurer.

They are so THIN! They must be starving.

You know what we need? A big steaming bowl of Squirmy Delight.

If you find yourself near a river, try rounding up some intact skitterer glands and I'll cook up a batch.

passages.title: Squirmy Delight
passages.text: Mama Bramblestaff always said Squirmy Delight will cure any hunger one way or another.

passages.title: Squirmy Delight
passages.text: Ha! With this I can make a stew potent enough to knock these waifish elves on their feet.

passages.title: Lotus Tea
passages.text:
The mogu really like their poisons and curses. Mama Bramblestaff always said lotus tea cures any mogu curse.

I saw some imperial lotus plants in the nearby Ruins of Dojan. We should go gather some of their leaves and keep them on hand just in case the mogu get unruly.

Also, this will give me a chance to introduce my fists to some mogu faces.

passages.title: Lotus Tea
passages.text: I have never seen the mogu this numerous before. They have always been a nuisance but never this bad.

passages.title: Lotus Tea
passages.text: That's it! You pick, I punch!

passages.title: Crane Mastery
passages.text:
Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.

Can't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.

Can I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here. There are a bunch of them so don't hesitate to hunt while doing other stuff.

passages.title: Crane Mastery
passages.text: Fantastic. Only thing that would make this hunting trip more entertaining is a chair. Here is the reward I promised you.

passages.title: No Sister Left Behind
passages.text:
We were searching the ruins south of here when the mogu fell upon us out of nowhere.

Some of us were able to retreat to this encampment but many others were captured. The mogu have also caught a number of the Horde who happened to be in the area as well.

Please, adventurer, rescue any sentinels that you can.

Leave the Dawnchasers to their fate.

passages.title: No Sister Left Behind
passages.text: There are so few of us, it is a great relief to see such help.

passages.title: Sever Their Supply Line
passages.text:
The mogu reclaimers are using portals to connect to Kun-Lai Summit, bringing in reinforcements and supplies.

What is worse, they are sending their captives through these portals.

Go to the Ruins of Korja and destroy as many of these Korjan Reclaimers as you can find.

passages.title: Sever Their Supply Line
passages.text: You have bought us some much needed breathing room to lick our wounds and prepare a counter-attack.

passages.title: Gryphon, Down
The Lord Reclaimer
passages.text:
They have my daughter! Brojai... that Lord Reclaimer! I can see him clearly through Lyalia's eyes.

That foolish girl must have tried to take him head on.

Please, adventurer! Go to the Ruins of Korja and try to free her.

I'll get Kang and try to draw out Brojai from the ruins with a distraction.

passages.title: The Lord Reclaimer
passages.text: Lyalia is the only family I have left. I had to bury her mother during the war of Ahn'Qiraj.

passages.title: The Lord Reclaimer
passages.text:
Thank you for avenging my daughter. I am not willing to let her stay dead however.

I still have the waters of youth.

passages.title: Tanks for Nothing!
Going on the Offensive
passages.text:
Ha! So my father just wasted twenty years of our lives on a fool's errand!

I'm taking charge.

When Tyrande sent us here she was very specific that we not come back until we find the source of the Light that she saw in her visions. It's obvious now that the Pools of Youth were not it.

I want you to look for my scout. I sent her to investigate the Crane Temple but she hasn't returned.

Get her report and rendezvous with us at the Sentinel Basecamp further west.

passages.title: Going on the Offensive
passages.text: Did you find the scout?

passages.title: Going on the Offensive
passages.text: <name>, well timed as usual. It turns out the mogu know how to use portals as well.

passages.title: Fly, Spy!
Sea Snakes
passages.text:
The rivers here are crawling with venomous aquatic snakes. Several evacuees were bitten as they fled from the temple, and already some are beginning to succumb to the poison.

We are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands.

I won't ask you to remove the glands in the field - that would take too long. Just bring back the heads and I'll take care of the rest.

passages.title: Hope Springs Eternal
passages.text:
The Shado-Pan are likely dealing with similar outbreaks elsewhere in Pandaria.

Seek out Loon Mai, the Shado-Pan Watch Commander in Stoneplow on the western end of the Valley of the Four Winds. Let him know that we have the situation here under control; the Shado-Pan need not send any aid.

Quite the opposite, in fact - I will be sending many of my followers on pilgrimage, to bring a message of hope to those in need.

Thank you again, adventurer. Farewell.

passages.title: Hope Springs Eternal
passages.text:
Finally, some good news. I will send a falcon to Winter's Blossom right away and let them know the Temple of the Red Crane is safe.

Between the sha outbreak and the increasing aggression of the mantid, our forces are being stretched thin.

passages.title: Minimum Safe Distance
Blind Them!
passages.text:
Horde sunwalkers! We saw one of their scouts patrolling by the oubliette not long before you arrived.

I don't know how he got here but I can guarantee you he isn't alone. They never are.

Kill the sunwalker scout before he reports our position.

passages.title: Blind Them!
passages.text:
Sunwalkers are not to be trusted. They are the most militant branch of the tauren armies within the horde.

Thank you for your help in this, <name>. Please accept this token as a reward.

passages.title: Setting Sun Garrison
passages.text:
I offer you my heartfelt appreciation for your aid. Anji awaits you in the Setting Sun Garrison to the west.

May the day favor you, young <class>.

passages.title: Setting Sun Garrison
passages.text: Welcome. Che send you?

passages.title: A Dish for Ella
passages.text:
Oh my, Shrimp Dumplings? My favorite!

Thank you.

passages.title: A Dish for Chee Chee
passages.text: Oh, Valley Stir Fry. Thanks!

passages.title: A Dish for Sho
passages.text: Ah, this is the best gift you could have given me! A warrior needs her strength.

passages.title: A Dish for Farmer Fung
passages.text: How did you know that this is my favorite dish? Thanks.

passages.title: A Dish for Fish
passages.text: Oh boy, this is my favorite! Thanks, <name>!

passages.title: A Dish for Tina
passages.text: Oh this is my favorite dish! Yum!

passages.title: Blanche's Boomer Brew
Walking on Sunwalkers
passages.text:
The tauren!

I refuse to let those flea bitten beasts claim the Pools of Youth for the Horde. None of their races have earned the right to immortality. They are by nature a series of short lived mortals who lack the humility and knowledge of how to properly support a long lived society.

They have infiltrators hunting for the pool. Kill those infiltrators before they find it. Their numbers are small so it shouldn't be that hard to cripple their eyes and ears.

passages.title: No Reprieve
passages.text:
We've been granted a brief respite from the mogu attacks as they attempt to recoup near the Five Sisters to our north. I would like you to see to it that they not be granted a similar reprieve.

Show no mercy.

passages.title: No Reprieve
passages.text: That should keep them off balance for a while. Thanks.

passages.title: The Scouts Return
passages.text:
<name>, your friends have returned from their scouting mission. They need to see you immediately.

I'm afraid...

Well, I'd better say no more. You will see for yourself.

passages.title: Going West
passages.text:
Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.

Kor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.

Track him down and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

passages.title: Going West
passages.text:
<name>! Well timed!
