Head out into the forest and pick a fight with a battle pet. Make sure to use your Track Pets skill so you can see pets you can fight on the minimap. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

passages.title: Learning the Ropes
passages.text: Nice work, <name>!  You're better with those pets than I thought!

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Erma, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Are your pets feeling better?

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now those look like some healthy pets, <name>.  Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text:
I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, <name>. I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.

Julia Stevens can be found at the Maclure Vineyards south of Stormwind. She is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced her in battle!

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: How is your team coming along? I have two snakes so far!

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: You're better with those pets than I thought!

passages.title: Emergency Response
passages.text:
Your companions have made themselves at home in our land, and brought with them a dangerous conflict.

The full extent of their destruction here we cannot yet know. Already it is... unspeakable.

Nevertheless, to forsake your friends out of spite would be against our way. Any that yet live are doubtlessly wounded and in desperate need of care.

These fireworks were to celebrate the statue's completion. Use them near your companions to signal Mishi, and she will bear them off to safety.

passages.title: Emergency Response
passages.text:
My thoughts will be with your fallen companions, traveler.

May their wounds mend well.

passages.title: Figuring out how to make quests
passages.text: Whee! You get to make a breadcrumb quest! Now figure out what to do next.

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: I'm excited to start my training. We start with sliced peaches, right?

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: I really want to be a chef, but the other kids already started a couple of months ago. There's no way I can catch up without your help.

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: Instant noodles aren't that hard to cook, right?

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: It's so easy to overcook the noodles!

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: Cooking is harder than I thought. It's so easy to burn things.

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: I hope I don't burn myself.  Eep.

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: I'm not very fond of mushrooms... but I'll do my best to learn.

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: Ick.

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: I love rice cakes. I'll do my best to make good ones!

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: I can't wait to see how they turn out!

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: A Token of Appreciation
passages.text: Thanks for checking to make sure I'm doing well! I've been able to help out the Ironpaws today, and they said I could give this to you.

passages.title: A Token of Appreciation
passages.text: You're my favorite teacher ever.

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text:
Sigh... you guessed it... Sheepie is gone... AGAIN.

Stupid sheep! Gives me so much trouble!

I hate to ask you again, but I promise this will be the last time.

Can you find him for me?

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text: Where's Sheepie?

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text:
What? Sheepie is... gone?

<Chee Chee's lip begins to quiver.>

passages.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
passages.text:
You have proven yourself in battle.

Still, if you would aid us further, I must ask something else of you.

The Sha of Violence awaits beyond within the Sealed Chambers. Destroy it if you would earn my respect.

passages.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
passages.text:
You have defeated the Sha of Violence and saved the monastery. You have my respect.

Perhaps we were wrong about your people, <name>.

passages.title: Mazu's Bounty
passages.text:
That was some amazing work you and the captain did out there, adventurer! It's an honor to have you on the crew.

Oh! And Ju Lien survived! He swam ashore just after you started letting the harpoons fly. He was raving about some kind of gigantic egg or something that washed in with Jiao.

Go check up on him, will you? He's probably hauled it out of the water by now.

passages.title: Mazu's Bounty
passages.text:
Hey there!

Oh, I'm fine. I've had worse spills than that after a night at the Chum Bucket.

But would you look at this thing? I spotted it peeking out of the sea floor when I went under - Jiao must have dredged it up while he was thrashing around.

Not really sure what to do with it, but it looks valuable. Seeing as how you pretty much saved all our hides, I think we owe you this catch.

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text:
We need reinforcements! Someone has to fight through and light the signal flame.

It's all up to you, <class>. No pressure or anything.

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text: <name>, you need to get out there and signal the reinforcements!

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text: Outstanding, <name>. Your timing couldn't have been better!

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text:
I sent a dozen of my best men ahead to infiltrate the mantid siege.

None have returned.

Since you are taking the fight directly to the mantid, you will be in a position to free any who had the misfortune to be captured.

You will do this?

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text: My men are being held somewhere amongst the mantid siege.

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text:
Thirteen thanks I give to you; twelve for those you rescued and my own as well.

Here's something else I give to you in gratitude.

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text:
If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.

I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text: You ready to catch some FISH?

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text:
If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.

I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text: You ready to catch some FISH?

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text:
The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

If you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon.

I betcha he'll be looking for help.

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text: You arrived just in time!

passages.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
passages.text:
The Order of the Cloud Serpent is always searching for talented riders.

If you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

I wish you luck, <race>.

passages.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
passages.text: Ah, have you come to join the Order?

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text:
The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

If you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon.

I betcha he'll be looking for help.

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text: You arrived just in time!

passages.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
passages.text:
The Order of the Cloud Serpent is always searching for talented riders.

If you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

I wish you luck, <race>.

passages.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
passages.text: Ah, have you come to join the Order?

passages.title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
passages.text:
Darkness enshrouds the Temple of the Jade Serpent, and Yu'Lon's priests beseech us for aid.

They hold the sha in check, but just barely.

You may be able to turn the tide, <class>.

passages.title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
passages.text: You've arrived just in time, <class>.

passages.title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
passages.text:
Darkness enshrouds the Temple of the Jade Serpent, and Yu'Lon's priests beseech us for aid.

They hold the sha in check, but just barely.

You may be able to turn the tide, <class>.

passages.title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
passages.text: You've arrived just in time, <class>.

passages.title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
passages.text:
The Temple of the Red Crane still reels from the aftermath of the sha's presence, and has only recently gathered to rebuild and retrain its warriors.

If you wish to help at the temple, speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji.

passages.title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
passages.text: Welcome, <class>.

passages.title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
passages.text:
The Temple of the Red Crane still reels from the aftermath of the sha's presence, and has only recently gathered to rebuild and retrain its warriors.

If you wish to help at the temple, speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji.

passages.title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
passages.text: Welcome, <class>.

passages.title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
passages.text:
Xuen, the great Celestial of the North, seeks the greatest champions in the land.

Today, he holds trials of battle at his temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

If you wish to test yourself against skilled fighters from all across Pandaria, then go to him and enter the challenger's ring!

passages.title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
passages.text: So you wish to test your skills? Very good, <race>.

passages.title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
passages.text:
Xuen, the great Celestial of the North, seeks the greatest champions in the land.

Today, he holds trials of battle at his temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

If you wish to test yourself against skilled fighters from all across Pandaria, then go to him and enter the challenger's ring!

passages.title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
passages.text: So you wish to test your skills? Very good, <race>.

passages.title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
passages.text:
Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid.

The great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever.

Go and help the defenders, <class>. The Temple must not fall!

passages.title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
passages.text: Well met, <class>! We need your help.

passages.title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
passages.text:
Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid.

The great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever.

Go and help the defenders, <class>. The Temple must not fall!

passages.title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
passages.text: Well met, <class>! We need your help.

passages.title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
passages.text:
We Shado-Pan have amassed our forces for the first time in many ages.

The Sha of Hatred has escaped beyond the Serpent's Spine, and it is our sacred duty to imprison it once more.

However, our warriors are great, but our numbers too few. Help from a capable <class> may not be turned away.

If you wish to join the offensive, speak to Taran Zhu in the Townlong Steppes.

passages.title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
passages.text: Well met, <race>.

passages.title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
passages.text:
The Shado-Pan rank among Pandaria's oldest defenders.

For years we train in our snow-capped monastery high in the Kun-Lai Summit, perfecting the martial secrets passed down by our ancestors.

Our numbers may seem few, but a single Shado-Pan can be deadlier than a hundred trained soldiers.

To join the Shado-Pan order is a long journey full of hardship. If this is the path you seek, then you must first prove your worth.

There is urgent work to be done here. Help the Golden Lotus defend the Vale.

passages.title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
passages.text:
Ah yes. <name>. Your name has traveled to us from the east.

We have seen your efforts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Already you have earned the esteem of the Golden Lotus.

Yes, we are interested to learn more about you.

passages.title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
passages.text:
We Shado-Pan have amassed our forces for the first time in many ages.

The Sha of Hatred has escaped beyond the Serpent's Spine, and it is our sacred duty to imprison it once more.

However, our warriors are great, but our numbers too few. Help from a capable <class> may not be turned away.

If you wish to join the offensive, speak to Taran Zhu in the Townlong Steppes.

passages.title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
passages.text: Well met, <race>.

passages.title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
passages.text:
The Shado-Pan rank among Pandaria's oldest defenders.

For years we train in our snow-capped monastery high in the Kun-Lai Summit, perfecting the martial secrets passed down by our ancestors.

Our numbers may seem few, but a single Shado-Pan can be deadlier than a hundred trained soldiers.

To join the Shado-Pan order is a long journey full of hardship. If this is the path you seek, then you must first prove your worth.

There is urgent work to be done here. Help the Golden Lotus defend the Vale.

passages.title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
passages.text:
Ah yes. <name>. Your name has traveled to us from the east.

We have seen your efforts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Already you have earned the esteem of the Golden Lotus.

Yes, we are interested to learn more about you.

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text:
Nobody is allowed into the Vale without the approval of the August Celestials. Xuen, The White Tiger, appears ready to listen to me.

But Taran Zhu of the Shado-Pan is reluctant to let the Alliance or Horde anywhere NEAR the Vale after all that's happened.

<Anduin shakes his head.>

Maybe you can help me make my case. Speak to the White Tiger on our behalf. Be careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text: Are you finished with the White Tiger's tasks?

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text:
You did it, <name>!

The White Tiger has agreed to allow us to accompany the Pandaren into the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. We can set up an Alliance outpost in there to act as our embassy with the Pandaren.

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text:
The human calf is arguing on our behalf. He is well-spoken; I can see why Baine Bloodhoof regards the prince so highly.

Still, the argument does not go well. I am of little consequence, but you are a hero of the Horde. Perhaps you can intercede in our favor?

Speak with the White Tiger and plead our case, <race>.

Be careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text: Have you passed the White Tiger's tests. <race>?

passages.title: A Celestial Experience
passages.text:
You did it, <name>!

The White Tiger has agreed to allow us to accompany the Pandaren into the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Where the Alliance Prince failed, a hero of the Horde prevailed.

passages.title: Dropping Our Signal
passages.text:
The beacon in Amberglow Hollow seems to have been tampered with. Right before the signal cut out the Klaxxi'va picked up a signal for another paragon nearby.

They believe he is hidden in that wretched little swamp, Duskroot Fen.

I will meet you in the fen to set up a temporary beacon until I can get Amberglow operational again.

You will wake the paragon and then you will help me.

passages.title: Dropping Our Signal
passages.text: It seems my work will begin immediately. You have come to a dangerous place, Wakener.

passages.title: Corruption Runs Deep
passages.text:
Today you learn that no one can be trusted in times of war, Wakener. Even those closest to the Klaxxi are susceptible to corruption.

Who knows how long this traitor has been corrupted. He must be destroyed!

You appear confused. Do you not see the traitor in our midst? Allow me to adjust your vision.

passages.title: Corruption Runs Deep
passages.text:
You will see more of this. War is never pretty.

The empresses' corruption is far reaching and hard to detect.

There is much work to be done. We need to start repairing the damage Kor'ik did.

passages.title: zzOld
An End to the Suffering
passages.text:
The key to lifting the curse of this place rests in the final death of Darkmaster Gandling.

Do it, adventurer, and make him suffer!

passages.title: An End to the Suffering
passages.text:
Behold my true form.

I owe you a debt, one which I can never repay. But, I thank you for lifting the curse off of my family.

Kel'Thuzad, the Lich King, and now Darkmaster Gandling -- all are dead.

Perhaps now I too can find some semblance of peace.

passages.title: The Missing Merchant
passages.text:
Usually, Merchant Shi comes through Kun-Lai Summit to trade with the Jinyu and Grummle. We've heard word that he hadn't been seen at Binan, and we haven't seen him here...

I'm worried something has happened to him. Can you go to the Inkgill Mere and see if he's there?

passages.title: The Missing Merchant
passages.text: My son! They took my son... Can you help me?

passages.title: The Missing Merchant
passages.text:
Usually, Merchant Shi comes through Kun-Lai Summit to trade with the Jinyu and Grummle. We've heard word that he hadn't been seen at Binan, and we haven't seen him here...

I'm worried something has happened to him. Can you go to the Inkgill Mere and see if he's there?

passages.title: The Missing Merchant
passages.text: My son! They took my son... Can you help me?

passages.title: The Shado-Pan
passages.text:
Our new recruits have spoken in hushed tones about a group of Pandaren they call the "Shado-Pan". They are apparently very strong, and secretive.

It's clear that, no matter what happens here in Kun-Lai, making an alliance with these Shado-Pan will be critical to our foothold in Pandaria.

That's where you come in. Rumor is they have a base of operations to the southeast, near Firebough Nook.

You will go there, and curry their favor. For the Horde!

passages.title: The Shado-Pan
passages.text: Who are you? Can you fight? If so, we can use your help.

passages.title: A Legend in the Making
passages.text:
Our world finds itself at a crossroads. The next few months will shape everything to come - presuming we are to have a future at all.

Ah! But I am getting ahead of myself. Let me back up. Come, share a drink with me. Let's talk about the future of Azeroth.

passages.title: A Legend in the Making
passages.text:
Of course, I must ask your discretion regarding what we just talked about.

We wouldn't want to alarm anyone who is, shall we say, less capable than yourself.

passages.title: Cho's Missive
passages.text:
One of those grummles came by and said that Lorewalker Cho sent for you. You should go ahead and meet up with him, he might have something important to say.

The grummel said he's at Onekeg, to the north.

passages.title: Cho's Missive
passages.text: Oh, hello. Nice to see you again.

passages.title: Cho's Missive
passages.text:
One of those adorable little grummles came by and said that Lorewalker Cho sent for you. You should meet up with him!

The grummel said he's at Onekeg, to the north.

passages.title: Cho's Missive
passages.text: Oh, hello. Nice to see you again.

passages.title: Way of the Pot
passages.text: The cuisine of the Way of the Pot help expand your intellect. Bring some jade lungfish to the Master of the Pot and she will teach you. You can fish for jade lungfish in the Jade Forest.

passages.title: Way of the Pot
passages.text: Want to learn the recipe for swirling mist soup?  Bring me some jade lungfish.

passages.title: Way of the Pot
passages.text: Good stuff. Now, let's get to your lesson.

passages.title: Incoming...
passages.text:
The Pandaren campaign is only beginning! We turn our attention now to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.

My contacts in Ravenholdt tell me that the Alliance 7th Legion and a considerable Horde invasion force are converging toward Pandaria's southern shores. Like it or not, Pandaria may soon become a battlefield.

We are done for now, but I want you to contact me when your fleet arrives. Then... together we will spring into action!

passages.title: Incoming...
passages.text:
They're here!

<Wrathion claps his hands and rubs them together, excitedly.>

Oh <name>. Things are about to get exciting.

passages.title: UNUSED
passages.text:
I am not a master chef like my siblings. What I am is a great teacher. If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are.

If you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn the recipe for soft-boiled eggs, make five of them and bring them to me. I have fresh eggs which I will sell to you at a token price.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Excuse me, <class>. Is your name <name>?

A figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.

The message comes from a tavern in the veiled stair. I'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you venture up there!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: So, my note found its way to you!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Excuse me, <class>. Is your name <name>?

A figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.

She mentioned the name "Wrathion." Does that ring any bells for you?

I'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you're going to deal with these people.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: So, we meet again!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.

passages.title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
passages.text:
There is a book of great value to me here in the halls.

Unfortunately, it's in the possession of Flameweaver Koegler. I've tried to get close to him before, but it's never quite worked out.

You might have better luck. Just watch out -- I hear that he's gone well and truly insane. The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library.

He'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.

passages.title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
passages.text: It's imperative that I get my hands on the codex.

passages.title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
passages.text:
Ah yes!

<The Hooded Crusader rubs her hands together gleefully at the sight of the codex.>

And now, I have a checklist with the name of every Scarlet Crusader on it!

You know... just in case any of them are unaccounted for. I don't like loose ends.

passages.title: Shortcut to Ruin
passages.text:
There is a champion among the loyalists, Vess-Guard Na'kal, whose strength comes not from experience or development, but from genetic modification. He was meant to be an example of the future of mantid - the sick idea that we can be born strong, without earning it.

He's a mockery of my work! Gene augmentation was meant for mature, post-swarm veterans ONLY!

End him. Perhaps it will serve as a lesson to Grand Empress Shek'zeer that taking shortcuts leads to ruin.

passages.title: Shortcut to Ruin
passages.text: I will not see my work used as a crutch to prop up the unworthy!

passages.title: Shortcut to Ruin
passages.text: My enhancements are tools for experienced warriors. Not toys for these fool children!

passages.title: Vess-Guard Duty
passages.text:
Vess-Guard Vik'az co-ordinates the defense forces at Zan'vess. He is worth ten mantid in battle, and his presence inspires the Zan'thik who fight alongside him.

Needless to say, we need him dead.

He patrols the housing area at the center of the island.

passages.title: Vess-Guard Duty
passages.text: Do not underestimate the impact of a precision strike. All of the Zan'thik will reel with the loss of Vik'az.

passages.title: Vess-Guard Duty
passages.text: One by one, her champions fall.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text:
The celestials are allowing us back into the Vale! This will be a sight to behold.

We shouldn't waste any time. Head to the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text: You must be <name>.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text:
Thank you for coming so quickly.

For thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.

Unfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
The problem with the Scarlet Crusade is that they keep coming back, even after death.

Behind those resurrections is High Inquisitor Whitemane. With her death, so goes the Crusade.

To give her the final rest, we need two swords of legend, each with a lost but storied history.

Luckily for me... er, us, these two blades of the anointed are at rest here within the monastery.

Find them and once you've killed Whitemane, plunge the blades into her corpse to make the death permanent.

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
<With one blade already in your possession, you move to take the other.>

<An inscription on the statue behind the sword reads, "The Hand of Providence".>

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
<The second anointed blade floats just in front of the wet statue. Steam rises from the sword.>

<You get the uncanny feeling that the Hand of Providence has been waiting for you.>

passages.title: Contending With Bullies
passages.text:
We honor strength here, not brutality. It is unfortunate but there are some who come to my doorstep oblivious to this distinction.

I have turned away one such challenger. In retaliation, he sacked the village of Yinying.

Go to Yinying Village southeast of the temple, and face this "Shonuf." Give him a lesson in true strength.

passages.title: Contending With Bullies
passages.text: It is a fine line between proving one's strength, and bullying.

passages.title: Contending With Bullies
passages.text: I commend your victory and thank you for dealing with that ruffian.

passages.title: The Vale of Eternal Blossoms
A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
passages.text: <name>, I need you to assemble a cunning group and venture forth into the depths of Scarlet Halls. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put a stop to Flameweaver Koegler's book-burning ways.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. Just the thought of him burning up that beautiful library makes me shudder. Your friends will appreciate the speed with which you dispatched him.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Scholomance. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Scholomance of Darkmaster Gandling's evil presence.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. May the skeletons of the dead remain peaceful now that Gandling no longer seeks to disturb their slumber.

passages.title: Mission: Culling The Vermin
passages.text:
I was sent to this valley to protect The Heartland from any potential threats.

I've identified a high priority target. The Springtail vermin burrow into the mountain cliffs, high above the farmlands.

Left unchecked, their numbers will multiply, and they will make their way down to the fields below.

They must be eliminated.

passages.title: Mission: Culling The Vermin
passages.text: What do you have to report?

passages.title: Mission: Culling The Vermin
passages.text: The targets are eliminated? Well done, <class>.

passages.title: Mission: The Hozen Dozen
passages.text:
I've been watching the hozen since I arrived, and I don't like the pattern of activity that I'm seeing in their camp.

Multiple hozen travel down the mountain under the cover of night, pillaging supplies from the farmlands below.

We must stop their rampant theft. I have been thinning their numbers when I can, but one soldier alone is not enough.

I need your help. Kill as many of the hozen as you can.

passages.title: Mission: Aerial Threat
passages.text:
I've identified another high risk target, one that most people would not suspect.

The cliff kites soaring above the hills to the east are quite dangerous.

I have seen them swooping down to the farms, snatching grain and seed when no one is looking.

In order to protect the farms, we must thin their numbers.

passages.title: Mission: Aerial Threat
passages.text: How goes the mission?

passages.title: Mission: Aerial Threat
passages.text: I knew you would carry out the mission without any problems. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Mission: Predator of the Cliffs
passages.text:
During my routine patrol of the mountains this morning, I spotted a huge white bird diving down to the farmlands.

It lifted an entire yak in its talons and disappeared among the cliffs.

Today a yak, tomorrow a farmhand!

We must eliminate this bird before it chooses its next victim.

passages.title: Mission: Predator of the Cliffs
passages.text: You did it, <name>! I feel at ease knowing the Valley safer now, because of you.

passages.title: Preserving Freshness
passages.text: To preserve maximum freshness, cooking ingredients need to be stored properly. Fortunately, Merchant Cheng over there sells good containers. I hate to send you on such a menial errand, but would you go purchase an empty tiger meat basket for me?

passages.title: Preserving Freshness
passages.text: Ingredients will spoil if not stored properly.

passages.title: Preserving Freshness
passages.text: Ah, good.  Now these ingredients will stay fresh until we're ready to cook.

passages.title: A Worthy Brew
passages.text:
There's one final person who needs to taste my brew.

I've heard that he's traveled far and wide, and tasted drinks from all over the world.

He happens to be in town, and I'd like to know what he thinks of my skills.

passages.title: A Worthy Brew
passages.text: There's always an opportunity to improve.

passages.title: A Worthy Brew
passages.text:
You aren't pulling my leg are ya, <name>? If he really said that, well... I guess... I guess it means I can do it, after all!

Thank you, <name>. You've really helped me gain confidence in myself.

passages.title: Learning the Ropes
passages.text:
Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills!

Head out into the valley and pick a fight with a battle pet. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

passages.title: Learning the Ropes
passages.text: Nice work, <name>!  You're better with those pets than I thought!

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Shelby Stoneflint, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now those look like some healthy pets, <name>.  Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.

passages.title: Got one!
passages.text:
Great work so far <name>. You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it. Now it's time to catch a pet of your own!

Head back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle and throw your trap once it's low on health. Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished.

Remember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!

passages.title: Got one!
passages.text:
I see... an excellent choice. You're on your way to building up a great team!

Remember, you have the opportunity to catch any pet you can fight, so go ahead and try to get as many as you can during your adventures.

passages.title: The Zan'thik Dig
passages.text:
We have just intercepted a message from an adjunct on Zan'vess. Yaungol laborers there have unearthed a paragon in the amber quarry on the back side of the island.

Get there immediately and free him before the Zan'thik destroy him!

passages.title: The Zan'thik Dig
passages.text:
<From the looks of it, this mantid was just recently broken out of his chamber. He lets out a hacking cough.>

...Diss-ec...tor... has... returned...

passages.title: The Dissector Wakens
passages.text:
You are... not like the others...

I hear the Klaxxi calling... <cough>

I just need a moment.

passages.title: The Dissector Wakens
passages.text:
<cough cough>

My head...

passages.title: The Dissector Wakens
passages.text:
Look at you! Many parts and pieces... yes... and all of them so good at killing. Fascinating.

I must pick your brain some time. Muhahah.

passages.title: The Kun-Lai Kicker
passages.text:
Have you ever seen the Brewmoon Festival?

The good folks of Binan Village host quite a party. And tonight's festivities are brew-catered by none other than yours truly here.

I am making my famous Kun-Lai Kicker!

Think you might come and join us for the festivities? It should be a completely relaxing event with absolutely no danger whatsoever.

passages.title: The Kun-Lai Kicker
passages.text: Ah, still alive I see...

passages.title: The Kun-Lai Kicker
passages.text: So I may have underestimated how safe it is to brew these days.

passages.title: Volatile Greenstone Brew
passages.text:
I am working on a batch of my famous Volatile Greenstone Brew.

Should be superb in countering the rascals and mischievous elementals we have been seeing around the mines lately.

Tell you what, how about you round up some of your friends and bring them back here to try out a round.

First one's on the house!

passages.title: Volatile Greenstone Brew
passages.text:
Sprites, jade destroyers, rocks that talk. This world is becoming a troublesome one.

But... nothing that can not be solved with a strong brew and winning smile.

And a solid punch or two.

passages.title: Volatile Greenstone Brew
passages.text: I see you put my Volatile Greenstone Brew to good use. Well done, <class>!

passages.title: The Threat in the South
passages.text:
With the Sha of Hatred dead, the greatest threat to this land is vanquished, but our travels along the southern border have made it exceedingly clear that the mantid forces in the Dread Wastes are on the move, and likely won't be held back for long.

If you wish to continue to aid the Shado-Pan, I would recommend reporting in to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine. She oversees the great wall that separates the terrors in the Dread Wastes from our bountiful lands to the east.

passages.title: The Threat in the South
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Not Fit to Swarm
passages.text:
Newly hatched mantid have only two instincts: kill and feed. They turn on one another, devouring the weak and leaving the strongest to mature.

Those hatched during a swarm - the swarmborn - are turned loose on our enemies instead.

The swarmborn in the Clutches of Shek'zeer have been tainted. They are born into shadows and nightmares. Driven by terror, not hunger.

They are not fit to swarm. They must be purged.

passages.title: Not Fit to Swarm
passages.text: Let me know if you want to be dropped into a sea of swarmborn. It would entertain me greatly.

passages.title: Not Fit to Swarm
passages.text:
Their eggs should have basked in the warmth of the sun and the song of a million wings for ten more years.

The Empress will pay for her crimes.

passages.title: Ancient Vengeance
passages.text:
I can hear them howling in rage... The spirits of the Gurthani mogu I slew so long ago. They wander this ruined terrace, seeking vengeance.

If they find me in this state, I will not have the strength to fend them off. Draw their attention and put them down.

Finish what I started, and I will tell you who I am.

passages.title: Ancient Vengeance
passages.text: The mogu of Clan Gurthan are quilen lords. Do not wake their guardians.

passages.title: Ancient Vengeance
passages.text:
We have a common enemy in the mogu. And perhaps others.

We shall see.

passages.title: Extending Our Coverage
passages.text:
The Klaxxi'va hear another paragon. His cries are weak and lost in darkness. The signal must be strengthened.

There is a tower in Amberglow Hollow that has been silent for many years. It must sing; The Klaxxi demand it!

This time I will go with you. You will help me repair it.

Take the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.

passages.title: Extending Our Coverage
passages.text:
It is good you showed up when you did.

The Klaxxi'va sing to the paragon now. Soon they will know where to send you. For now there are other tasks.

passages.title: Crime and Punishment
passages.text:
The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken.

The Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.

passages.title: Crime and Punishment
passages.text: The Klaxxi are pleased with our work, outsider. You have proven to be more resourceful than we thought.

passages.title: Valley of the Four Winds
passages.text: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin. Talk with me when ye be ready to go and I can give ye a ride ta where ya need to go. Talk to me cohort on the other side 'ta get some equipment to aid ya on yer journey.

passages.title: Valley of the Four Winds
passages.text: Welcome to Pandaria, <class>.  I have a selection of equipment that you may find useful on your journey.

passages.title: Thinning the Sik'thik
passages.text:
For all our efforts to keep the mantid in the Dread Wastes, some have broken through, seemingly intent on Niuzao Temple. My men have been attempting to extinguish their presence to the west, at Sik'vess, but to no success. If you're half of the <class> Taran paints you to be, maybe you will fare better.

Head west, and kill any Sik'thik mantid you find. And remember, this is no time for mercy. There are lives at the temple depending on us.

passages.title: Thinning the Sik'thik
passages.text:
The mantid are relentless. Fortunately for us, you have a dedication that surpasses even theirs.

It is good to have you walk these roads, <class>.

passages.title: The Search for Restless Leng
passages.text:
One of my best scouts, Restless Leng, went missing during a mission on the other side of Sik'vess. I'm hopeful that he was captured rather than killed, but with the mantid corrupted so heavily by sha, it doesn't seem likely.

Still, can you investigate the cages around Sik'vess? I owe him a more thorough search than even this, but I have no men to spare without allowing our southern lines to break.

Please, <class>, even if there's no life left in him, find him that I might know his fate.

passages.title: The Search for Restless Leng
passages.text: Leng told me of your heroics. He is in your debt, as am I.

passages.title: The Dreadsworn
passages.text:
The Klaxxi see far and hear much. They have shared their insight with me.

The Vor'thik embrace the sha, using its power to fuel their march in this false swarm. Their warriors consume tainted amber and call themselves dreadsworn.

There is no future for them. They are waste which needs disposing.

And YOU will begin that process for us when you reach Kypari Vor.

passages.title: The Dreadsworn
passages.text:
In disciplined hands, the spear is the perfect weapon. Only the weak would augment it with sorcery.

And we have no need for the weak.

passages.title: Inscribed Tiger Staff
passages.text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

passages.title: Inscribed Tiger Staff
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Inscribed Tiger Staff
passages.text: This is a weapon of great beauty and power.  If you are certain you wish to part with it, I would be happy to take it from you.

passages.title: Inscribed Crane Staff
passages.text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

passages.title: Inscribed Crane Staff
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Inscribed Crane Staff
passages.text: This is a weapon of great beauty and power.  If you are certain you wish to part with it, I would be happy to take it from you.

passages.title: Inscribed Serpent Staff
passages.text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

passages.title: Inscribed Serpent Staff
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Inscribed Serpent Staff
passages.text: This is a weapon of great beauty and power.  If you are certain you wish to part with it, I would be happy to take it from you.

passages.title: Julia Stevens
passages.text: Think you can take me again?

passages.title: Julia Stevens
passages.text: There's nobody I can't beat!

passages.title: Julia Stevens
passages.text: Ouch, you really are a good pet trainer! I guess you're the exception.

passages.title: Sprite Fright
passages.text:
Oh bother, how am I supposed to get my tasks done, now?

Instructor Skythorn asked me to go kill some tigers at Windward Isle, but I heard the area was overrun with sprites!

Ugh! I hate sprites! They totally give me the creeps!

They're so small, and... and... they jump on you and... and... they have cold, dead little stick hands!

Auuugh! You have to help me, <name>. Get rid of those things, please!

passages.title: Sprite Fright
passages.text: You have put the sprites in their place, <name>. They should cause no more trouble for a while.

passages.title: Dark Huntress
passages.text:
I have learned that a vicious beast, a Windward Huntress, terrorizes the wood on the northwest side of the island.

She has already slain several serpents, and injured more than one serpent rider sent to subdue her.

She must be removed before she can pose a danger to anyone else. Can you perform this task?

passages.title: Dark Huntress
passages.text: Wild creatures can be savage and cruel.

passages.title: Dark Huntress
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. You are proving to be quite a reliable student.

passages.title: On The Prowl
passages.text:
I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island.

This savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs.

We cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked.

Go and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.

passages.title: On The Prowl
passages.text: I see you have vanquished the beast. Quite a promising student, you are.

passages.title: Madcap Mayhem
passages.text:
There is another task I must ask of you.

The leader of the woodland sprites is the Shadowfae Madcap.

If there is trouble brewing, he is the mastermind pulling the puppet strings.

We do not have time to deal with the sprites' tiresome pranks and insolence. Take out the Shadowfae Madcap, and be quick about it.

passages.title: Madcap Mayhem
passages.text: Good riddance. With everything that is worrying us these days, it is good to have one less problem to worry about.

passages.title: Weeping Widows
passages.text:
The spiders near Sri-La Village have grown very aggressive. They pose a severe problem to the anglers who fish along the coast.

For their safety, I need you to go and eliminate the Weeping Widows in The Widow's Wail.

You can find the cave along the coast to the north.

passages.title: Weeping Widows
passages.text: Instructor Skythorn updated me on the situation at The Widow's Wail. You have done well.

passages.title: Serpent's Scale
passages.text:
I see you have gained your own hatchling, <race>.

Have you been feeding it, cleaning after it, and playing with it properly? Only by doing so will it become strong and healthy.

Now let me tell you a trainer's secret. To the north, in The Widow's Wail, you can find a mushroom known as Serpent's Scale.

It is difficult to acquire, but this mushroom has powerful properties and important nutrients. Your serpent won't like eating it, but who likes eating their vegetables?

passages.title: Serpent's Scale
passages.text: <Your serpent greets you happily.>

passages.title: Serpent's Scale
passages.text: <Your serpent sniffs the mushrooms and makes a horrible face. It tries to escape, but you hold it gently and coax it to eat the spongy morsels.>

passages.title: The Seed of Doubt
passages.text:
The problem with the sha of doubt, <race>, is its deceitful pervasiveness.

Once the seed of doubt is planted, it can grow like an unwelcome weed.

Such a seed has been planted in The Widow's Wail to the north, and like a weed, we must extinguish its presence immediately.

I need you to destroy the lingering fragment of doubt before it can infect any more victims.

passages.title: The Seed of Doubt
passages.text: Doubt is a difficult enemy to vanquish because in a sense, we are fighting ourselves. Stand tall and be confident in your own actions, <name>.

passages.title: The Seed of Doubt
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. I "doubt" that this enemy is truly gone. Until we can be sure, we must stay vigilant.

passages.title: Monkey Mischief
passages.text:
Strange tales have reached our ears from Sri-La Village.

It seems that a hozen tribe has made itself comfortable in Oona Kagu, a cave along the coast south of the fishing village.

Too comfortable, in fact. The tribe members are stealing and pillaging resources all along the coast.

We must teach them a lesson... one that can only be taught by force. They have already overstayed their welcome.

passages.title: Monkey Mischief
passages.text: We serve the people of The Jade Forest. We will ensure their protection and well-being.

passages.title: Monkey Mischief
passages.text: The hozen presence is quite troubling. You did well to follow Instructor Skythorn's instructions.

passages.title: The Big Brew-haha
passages.text:
It's a disaster, <name>!

When I went to visit the Dancing Serpent Inn yesterday, they were all out of brew. They said the shipment from Sri-La Village had been stolen. STOLEN!

Turns out those Oona hozen have been making all kinds of trouble down at the docks, including taking all the brew to their cave at Oona Kagu along the coast.

I can't handle a dry spell. A life without brew is not a life worth living!

Someone needs to go and save the brew!

passages.title: The Big Brew-haha
passages.text: Is the brew recovered yet? I'm... I'm starting to lose it...

passages.title: The Big Brew-haha
passages.text: Oh, thank the Stormstouts! You are my hero!

passages.title: The Big Kah-Oona
passages.text:
The leader of the Oona hozen is a brigand by the name of Lord Oona.

I have heard fearsome tales of this roaming sea captain and his crew. Everywhere he takes his tribe, destruction follows.

The Oona land their boats on fertile soil, pillage the local villages, and drain the land dry before moving on to their next conquest.

We shall not allow the same to occur on our shores, not while I am still in charge.

I need someone to go eradicate him now.

passages.title: The Big Kah-Oona
passages.text: The leader is dead, then? Good. Perhaps now the hozen will leave the villagers in peace.

passages.title: Pooped
passages.text:
<As you approach the pen, the serpent zips into a corner and hides.>

As it looks at you with bashful eyes, you can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had... an accident.

Well, at the rate that the serpent's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere.

You had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.

passages.title: Pooped
passages.text: <The hatchling watches you in amusement.>

passages.title: Pooped
passages.text: The hatchling plays contentedly, oblivious to your efforts. Sigh... sometimes, the life of a serpent trainer is quite thankless.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ace Longpaw
passages.text:
You are rising up the ranks of our students, <name>.

Just as a sword must be forged through fire, so must our students test themselves against one another.

Today, you will spar against one of our brightest disciples, Ace Longpaw. In order to defeat him, you will need to make use of your defensive capabilities.

Speak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ace Longpaw
passages.text: Well done, <class>. The sword that is hammered and folded produces a keen blade.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Big Bao
passages.text:
Are you ready for another lesson, <name>?

Today, you will spar against Big Bao. He is large of stature and of heart, and he will not give up until he is wholly beaten.

If you wish to defeat him, you will need to persevere.

Speak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Big Bao
passages.text: Both of you persevered to the end. Well done, my student.

passages.title: Valley of the Four Winds
Old MacDonald
passages.text:
You're tough for just starting out!

Old MacDonald taught me everything I know about battling. I think fighting him would be a great learning experience for you!

He can be found just across the bridge leading to Westfall. Don't let his age fool you, he's already beaten quite a few up-and-coming trainers like yourself.

passages.title: Old MacDonald
passages.text: You must think you're a real ace, don't you?

passages.title: Old MacDonald
passages.text: Well, I can't argue with results like those. You've got a real gift, <name>.

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text:
Are you ready to show off what you can do? There's a little girl up in Redridge Mountains that has made a real storm on the battle scene.

Find Lindsay at the dock at Camp Everstill. She may be young, but her impressive record is nothing to be scoffed at!

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text: Who taught you how to fight, mister?

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text: You're mean! Why didn't you let me win? Everyone always lets me win!

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text:
I heard all my friends talking about a scary worgen called Eric Davidson in Duskwood that nobody ever fights with their pets.

I bet if you found and beat him, people might talk about you instead!

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text: Are you afraid, <race>?

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text: Not only do you not fear me or my home, you have defeated me honorably. I'm impressed.

passages.title: Gambling Problem
passages.text:
If this war is to be won we cannot afford to leave anything unchecked, outsider.

There is a disturbance along the coast that needs to be investigated. The presence there is not our kind and are of no value to us. However, their supplies could prove very valuable.

If there is anything of use there we must get to it before the empress.

passages.title: Gambling Problem
passages.text:
So the bugs have taken an interest in us have they? Well if they want somethin' from us they'll have to come and earn it themselves!

You work for what you get here. That means you too!

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text:
My longtime friend, fellow trainer, and infamous drunkard Bill Buckler of the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!

You should answer his call and really put your skills to the test. He tends to wander the southern roads of the Cape.

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text: You aren't sho tough ...hic!

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text: I demand a do-over ...hic! That washn't fair! There was two of ye!

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text:
If you thought I was tough, prepare yourself. The road only gets harder from here.

Find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text: Where did you acquire such an intriguing team?

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text: What a show! A most excellent skirmish indeed.

passages.title: A Not So Friendly Request
passages.text:
Scouts have reported a non-mantid presence near Kor'vess. Their intrusion and their theft of amber would normally be dealt with swiftly, but our forces are needed elsewhere.

This task seems suited to you, Wakener. You will convince them to leave this land, or you will destroy them in the name of the Klaxxi'va.

passages.title: A Not So Friendly Request
passages.text:
So they want us to leave do they? What a selfish request! We're only taking amber from one tree.

Well, I'm not going anywhere! I have brew to make.

If you help us maybe we can all come to a mutually beneficial agreement. I give them some brew, they stop trying to kill us.

passages.title: Welcome Wagons
passages.text:
Did you see the size of those war wagons? They're packing so many explosives, I cannae tell if the Horde is here to take over this continent or just blow it out of the sea!

We need to neutralize those wagons before they leave Garrosh'ar Point.

Here, take me pocket flares. Fire 'em into a wagon and watch the fireworks!

passages.title: Welcome Wagons
passages.text: Did "The Pickle" send you with a mission?

passages.title: Welcome Wagons
passages.text: With those wagons out of commission, we can turn our attention to the commander.

passages.title: Envoy of the Alliance
passages.text:
North of this base is a cherry blossom orchard and a village tucked away behind it. We will need to quarter there and tend to our wounded while we plan our next move.

Head to that village and make contact with the native leader. Agent Mishka and I will rendezvous with you there.

Be courteous, <name>! I am authorizing you to represent the entire Alliance here.

I'm banking that seeing a powerful Alliance hero like you should make a favorable impression.

passages.title: Envoy of the Alliance
passages.text:
When the mist fell, we knew it would only be a matter of time before visitors arrived.

We could not have predicted it would be like this.

passages.title: The Cost of War
passages.text:
This whole place is going up in flames and the Skyfire is reporting that more of those... shadows are crawling up out of the ground. We need to get our people out of here.

Clear a path through the base on your way north and head for the town. I will rendezvous with you there.

passages.title: The Cost of War
passages.text: You have no idea what kind of consequences your actions may have here!

passages.title: The Cost of War
passages.text: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Rell."

passages.title: Pillaging Peons
passages.text:
How did my village become a battlefield?

To the west, your Horde enemies cut down our precious orchard. Without our apple trees, we will have no harvest, no food, and no livelihood.

If you are truly different than this Horde, show us! Help us protect our grove by killing those who defile the land.

passages.title: Pillaging Peons
passages.text: It is easier to harbor hatred than to make peace.

passages.title: Pillaging Peons
passages.text: Our orchard is one of our village's greatest treasures. For saving our harvest, we are truly grateful.

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text:
Those "orc" things ransacked the brewery and made off with my family's finest barrels of cider.

I know there is a war out there, but I am not a brewer who will stand idly by while his prized vintage is chugged by undeserving lips.

The "Horde" will likely put up some resistance. Why don't you put that weapon to good use and help me recover my cider?

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text: Is that my husband with you? Did you recover the cider?

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text: I see that you two have been busy. Thank you for recovering our kegs.

passages.title: Koukou's Rampage
passages.text:
We have more than just our cellars to worry about.

Koukou, our beloved mushan, has gone crazy! Just look at him!

I've tried cajoling and pleading and yelling and soothing, but nothing has worked.

I'm afraid he is no longer of his own mind. There is only one way to save him, and our brewery.

Strike swift and sure. He will not feel a thing.

passages.title: Koukou's Rampage
passages.text: Things are going crazy around here, and it all started when you arrived, <race>.

passages.title: Koukou's Rampage
passages.text:
You did well to help the Brewers and bring this news to me.

From what you have told me, it sounds as if Koukou was possessed by some dark energy. Could it be...?

No. That is impossible.

passages.title: Twinspire Keep
passages.text:
I do not trust this Horde. They wield foul magic, and their intentions are clearly malevolent. We can no longer stand their presence in Twinspire Keep, so close to Paw'don.

I beg you, visitor: thin their numbers before they do something awful to this village.

passages.title: Twinspire Keep
passages.text: Gol' dang, but there's a bunch of 'em down there...

passages.title: Twinspire Keep
passages.text:
One heck of a bloody mess y'made down there, kid.

Nice work.

passages.title: Fractured Forces
passages.text:
The Horde have made our jobs easier for us. Their infighting and segregation have split their camp in two: orcs in the west, and undead in the east.

The orcs obey their commander Dalgan, while the undead follow Bellandra Felstorm, a powerful warlock. Hopefully, their internal squabbles will be enough of a distraction that you'll be able to sneak in there and kill both of them. Sully has already infiltrated the ruins; find him inside when you are done.

passages.title: Fractured Forces
passages.text: Pretty scary-lookin' characters around here...

passages.title: Fractured Forces
passages.text:
That's some fine and fancy killin', <class>.

Now, with those two all done 'n' taken care of, all that's left is the big fella in the hall behind me.

passages.title: Cannonfire
passages.text: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?

passages.title: Cannonfire
passages.text:
It's a bit more quiet out now. My ringing ears appreciate your hard work.

Thanks!

passages.title: High Chance of Rain
passages.text:
The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them.

You should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.

passages.title: High Chance of Rain
passages.text:
It's a lot brighter out! And not just thanks to your sunny smile.

Way to go!

passages.title: Unleashed Spirits
passages.text:
The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight.

Kill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you.

Good luck.

passages.title: Unleashed Spirits
passages.text:
The spirits still come, but our guards can hold them back. The Shao-Tien cannot keep this up for ever.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Laosy Scouting
passages.text:
Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue.

We probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?

passages.title: Laosy Scouting
passages.text: You're a good man, helping that silly rogue out more than he deserves.

passages.title: Breaking Their Spirits (Not Yet Implemented)
passages.text:
The mogu have piled the bodies of our brethren high at the top of the Golden Stair, and are conducting some foul ritual to tear their spirits from their bodies and turn them on us.

Find this ritual and stop it. Leave them a firm reminder of what will happen if they attempt this again.

passages.title: Crumbling Behemoth
passages.text:
The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us.

In response, I would like to unleash you upon it.

It approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...

passages.title: Crumbling Behemoth
passages.text: Glorious.  They will learn to fear us.

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text:
Nazgrim has taken command of the ground assault and has requested that you be sent to meet up with him immediately.

We have several rappelling ropes setup near the guns. Fastest way down you're going to find, save the one that ends poorly.

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text: What?

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text:
There you are!

I was starting to worry we'd have to charge in and have all the fun without you.

passages.title: Finish Them!
passages.text:
We've softened them up. Now it's time to finish them off!

That fortress must be cleansed of Alliance, and we've got nowhere to keep any prisoners.

<The hint of a smile crosses Nazgrim's face.>

You know what to do, <name>. The cowards will run if you give them the chance.

See that you don't!

passages.title: Finish Them!
passages.text: Destroy them all!

passages.title: Finish Them!
passages.text: Good work, <class>! We have them on their heels!

passages.title: Fire Is Always the Answer
passages.text:
It's not enough that we destroy their forces. Nothing must be left for them to salvage!

Take this flare-gun and fire it into their munitions stockpiles. Leave them nothing!

passages.title: Fire Is Always the Answer
passages.text: Burn them out!

passages.title: Fire Is Always the Answer
passages.text:
Haha! Good work, <name>.

Leave 'em nothing!

passages.title: The Final Blow!
passages.text:
We've learned that their captain has barricaded himself in above us.

The coward allowed his forces to die while he hid from our fury! Typical Alliance! No matter. He cannot delay his fate any longer.

I will scale the walls with my marines while you lead a frontal assault up the ramps. Use your flare gun on munitions near the barricades to blast your way through.

We will meet you up top and destroy this pathetic excuse for a captain together!

passages.title: The Final Blow!
passages.text:
An air base - they had a hidden airbase here this entire time! Had I known I would've kept more men on the guns, I would've - Uaaghh -

<The color drains from Nazgrim's face, and his body begins to exude a mysterious dark energy.>

passages.title: Face to Face With Consequence
passages.text:
I do not know the history of this war that you fight, and I am not interested. This land responds to negative energy in kind. The hatreds, doubt, and violence you have brought here now ooze out of Pandaria like blood from an open wound.

Your actions have wrought havoc all over these ruins! Clean up after yourself and meet me in the village below - I will do my best to explain what is happening here.

passages.title: Face to Face With Consequence
passages.text: Have you cleansed the ruins?

passages.title: Face to Face With Consequence
passages.text: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Nazgrim."

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text:
Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste!

Taran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get.

We were on our way to Dawn's Blossom when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost!

You want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.

passages.title: Prowler Problems
passages.text:
The animals have all gone crazy!

Normally the prowlers steer clear of the village, but now we can't seem to keep them away. I've never seen them act this way before!

The mayor has summoned in the Shado-Pan, but they're not all here yet. Can you take care of those prowlers before they maul one of our farmers?

passages.title: Prowler Problems
passages.text:
Ah, so your conflict at the ruins is beginning to pollute the local wildlife? This is very troubling - I have never seen a reaction so intense.

Thank you for protecting the village, but it is a tragedy that those poor animals had to die.

passages.title: Assault on the Airstrip
passages.text:
I have found their hidden airfield, <name>: the Strongarm Airstrip. It wasn't hard to spot, it's swarming with Alliance.

<Nazgrim spits.>

They think they've wiped us out, but we're Horde! We fight until we're corpses... and sometimes even afterwards. Let them taste our steel!

passages.title: Assault on the Airstrip
passages.text:
The best thing about killing Alliance in Pandaria? It'll be months before they get any reinforcements.

This land will belong to the Horde, <class>. We're nearly finished.

passages.title: The Darkness Within
passages.text:
You didn't see Captain Doren while you were out there, did you?

That sniveling Alliance leader must be in hiding somewhere. If he wasn't in that airbase, he can't be far. Search the perimeter - try searching the cave southwest of the main airfield. I want the Alliance gone from here!

passages.title: The Darkness Within
passages.text: On your way then, <name>.

passages.title: The Darkness Within
passages.text:
The Alliance have been routed. You, Nazgrim, Kiryn, Gorrok, Shokia, and Rivett need a base of operations.

These flags will have to be changed.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Old MacDonald
passages.text: I won't be such a pushover this time around!

passages.title: Old MacDonald
passages.text: Just where do they raise trainers like you, anyway?

passages.title: Old MacDonald
passages.text: I guess I still have a lot to learn.

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text: Think you can take me again? I'm always up for challenge!

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text: You aren't so tough!

passages.title: Lindsay
passages.text: That wasn't fun at all!

passages.title: Rampage Against the Machine
passages.text:
Kovok has progressed at an astonishing rate. Perhaps the years in hibernation effected his growth process...

Whatever the reason, this could not have come at a better time. I believe it is time to test his abilities.

You have done so much to aid in his training. It is only fitting that you assist him in his first battle.

I've already guided him to the edge of the scar. Find him and destroy Shek'zeer's army!

passages.title: Rampage Against the Machine
passages.text: Was the battle glorious?! How many of Shekzeer's army fell to Kovok?

passages.title: Rampage Against the Machine
passages.text: I was able to glimpse moments of the battle through your mind. It looked to be a massacre! Well done!

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text:
I can no longer call myself your teacher, <name>.

You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent.

Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text: Today, we become brethren. Congratulations on joining the Order of the Cloud Serpent. Let us ride together!

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text:
I can no longer call myself your teacher, <name>.

You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent.

Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

passages.title: Riding the Skies
passages.text: Today, we become brethren. Congratulations on joining the Order of the Cloud Serpent. Let us ride together!

passages.title: Zunta, The Pet Tamer
passages.text:
I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, <name>. I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.

Zunta can be found near the Tor'kren Farm south of Orgrimmar. He is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced him in battle!

passages.title: Zunta, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: Who be sendin' you to face Zunta?

passages.title: Zunta, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: Ah, Varzok. Yes, I know him well. He be makin' no mistake in sendin' you here.

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text:
Der be another trainer not far from here that you ought to fight to test your worth.

Dagra the Fierce waits on the northern slope of Thorn Hill, east of The Crossroads. If you be beatin' her, you just might have what it takes.

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text: I fear nothing. I will not be defeated!

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text: You fight with the determination of one who does not fear defeat, but does not tolerate it, either. You will go far.

passages.title: Analynn
passages.text:
Determination is naught without proper challenge.

Find Analynn wandering the roads in western Ashenvale. She is a bit...eccentric...but a fine trainer nonetheless! Fighting her will harden your team.

passages.title: Analynn
passages.text: You do not understand. I have not been defeated, merely set back.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text:
<name>, a rare opportunity has arisen that I think you will be interested in.

Zonya the Sadist in southern Stonetalon Mountains has returned to the battle scene. I must suggest that you face her to further hone your own abilities as a tamer.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text: You be messin' with da wrong troll, mon.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text: Did you enjoy the taste of victory? It'll be your last, mon. Things do not get easier from here.

passages.title: Traitor Gluk
passages.text:
Are you up for an adventure? Bill the Pirate, local star tamer down in the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!

You can find Bill the Pirate in the southern Cape of Stranglethorn, walking the local roads to find potential fights.

passages.title: Merda Stronghoof
passages.text:
Are you ready for a real measure of your prowess, <race>?

Merda Stronghoof has made camp at da place dey call Karnum's Glade in the Cenarion Wildlands of Desolace. Fighting a trainer as powerful as her will put your skills to the test, eh?

passages.title: Merda Stronghoof
passages.text: The resilience of Desolace cannot compare to your own desire to grow. I applaud your efforts.

passages.title: Zunta
passages.text: Think you can take me again, eh?

passages.title: Zunta
passages.text: You be a worthy opponent, mon.

passages.title: Zunta
passages.text: Lay off, mon! Lay off! You win!

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text: You climbed this mountain once more only to face your own demise.

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text: You have much to learn before I will call you my superior.

passages.title: Dagra the Fierce
passages.text: Impossible!

My next task for you is to fight a few battles and raise a pet to level 3. Once you do that, come back and see me and we can talk about catching your own pets!

passages.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Master Cheng
passages.text: Welcome Back, <name>. I see you've returned to hone your skills. Speak with Master Cheng in the Training Grounds below us for a practice sparring session.

passages.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Master Cheng
passages.text: Spar with Master Cheng.

passages.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Master Cheng
passages.text: I hear from Master Cheng that your training went well.  Come back again in the future to continue your training.

passages.title: Better Dead than Dread
passages.text:
I am sure many of our associates will be requesting your services after your victory here. But I have received a request for aid from our defenders at the wall along the Dread Wastes.

If you would assist them, then take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

passages.title: Better Dead than Dread
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text: Ah, so you've braved the woods again to face me in battle. I accept your brazen challenge to my vicious spawn.

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text: Do you feel your imminent defeat creeping up on you, like a spider to its struggling prey?

passages.title: Eric Davidson
passages.text: Your risk has paid its reward.

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text:
So ye've come fer another round, have ye?

I'll show ya why they be callin' me the shcourge o' the vale!

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text: I've sheen better ...hic!

passages.title: Bill Buckler
passages.text: You be the victor today, lad, but next time I won't be takin' it so eashy on ye!

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text: You dare to challenge me again? This time, I do believe our battle is going to sway in my favor!

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text: I do so very much enjoy our bouts.

passages.title: Steven Lisbane
passages.text: A thrilling match! Splendid! Well done indeed!

passages.title: All Aboard!
passages.text:
You hear all of that, <name>? There are Alliance that need killing and I need to round up a veteran crew.

You're coming with me!

We won't be returning until our assignment's complete, so round up your things and make ready.

I'll be aboard a newly commissioned gunship over Bladefist Bay.

Don't keep me waiting!

passages.title: All Aboard!
passages.text:
Welcome aboard Hellscream's Fist, <name>!

This'll be her maiden voyage. Ain't she a beauty?

passages.title: Analynn
passages.text: I see you have once again found me. I presume you wish to do battle once more? Yes, let's.

passages.title: Analynn
passages.text: What do your pets say to you when you are victorious?

passages.title: Analynn
passages.text: Your pets are ecstatic about their victory. I hope you are as well.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text: The prey be walkin' to the predator's territory, unaware of the danger that <he/she> is in. You be givin' Zonya no trouble dis time.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text: Pain be the sound of victory, mon.

passages.title: Zonya the Sadist
passages.text: You think yourself victorious, but I be growin' stronger with each defeat.

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text:
Cassandra Kaboom is a fierce tamer, known for her mechanical pets. She should serve as the next step on your journey to greatness.

Find her in Southern Barrens near the Frazzlecraz Motherlode and challenge her. Beating Cassandra will surely prove yourself in the eyes of Varzok.

Good luck.

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text: What's a <race> like you doin' in a place like this?

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text: Woah! You really are somethin'!

passages.title: Traitor Gluk
passages.text: You beat Gluk before, but now Gluk lay da smackdown on puny <race>!

passages.title: Traitor Gluk
passages.text: Me crush you!

passages.title: Traitor Gluk
passages.text: No! Gluk no lose! Rematch!

passages.title: Merda Stronghoof
passages.text: Just as the land continues to grow, my team is stronger than ever. Are you sure you wish to combat me? There is no shame in admitting defeat now.

passages.title: Merda Stronghoof
passages.text: What is your approach to training? I prefer to make my team one with the land that supports us.

passages.title: Merda Stronghoof
passages.text: Your victory is well-deserved. Your skills are superior to my own.

passages.title: The Inkmasters of the Arboretum
passages.text: I have heard that the Inkmasters at the Arboretum are in need of aid from a scribe of great skill. You should speak with Inkmaster Wei, if you wish to help.

passages.title: The Inkmasters of the Arboretum
passages.text: Ah, a scribe of great skill. Some of us here could really use your help.

passages.title: The Inkmasters of the Arboretum
passages.text: I have heard that the Inkmasters at the Arboretum are in need of aid from a scribe of great skill. You should speak with Inkmaster Wei, if you wish to help.

passages.title: Audrey Burnhep
passages.text:
I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, <name>. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!

Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

passages.text:

Take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Pet Battle Trainers: Kalimdor
passages.text:
It's time to put your battle skills to a true test.

You will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

passages.title: Battle Pet Trainers: Kalimdor
passages.text:
The very same trainers you bested before in Kalimdor have challenged you once more. No doubt they have not forgotten your last victory!

Seek them out and show them your prowess!

passages.title: A Delicate Balance
passages.text:
The calling to be a Shado-pan is one to bring balance and harmony to this land. It is our duty to ensure balance is maintained, <name>.

The yaungol activity in Townlong is threatening this balance and must be stopped before it is too late.

We've had sightings of yaungol in the Sumprushes. The reports indicate they are attacking the mist lurkers in the area. Find out why and put an end to it!

passages.title: A Delicate Balance
passages.text:
