<Orbiss groans at you in agony.>

So, the shado-pan have sent you to see what the yaungol are doing? Well, do you see?

passages.title: Better Off Dread
passages.text:
It's time we go to the source, <name>!

Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled <class> such as yourself.

Seek out Bowmistress Li atop the Serpent's Spine on the border of Dread Wastes.

passages.title: Better Off Dread
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: Word around the master tamers in Kalimdor is you're the new hotshot that's making such a buzz. Why don't you come down to my training grounds in the Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring so I can show you how it's done?

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: You're tougher than you look!

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: You really are some sort of hotshot, aren't ya? You won't be so lucky next time!

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text: I've loaded my pets with new gyrotechnic training modules. You're going down!

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text: You're a punk!

passages.title: Cassandra Kaboom
passages.text: I must've converted a line wrong somewhere...

passages.title: Grazzle the Great
passages.text: You're back?! You're just asking to get eaten by a black dragon!

passages.title: Grazzle the Great
passages.text: I've seen better.

passages.title: Grazzle the Great
passages.text: It's like my pretties have lost their will to fight.

passages.title: Kela Grimtotem
passages.text: You're so bold as to venture into the heart of Grimtotem lands once more to challenge me? You will regret your decision!

passages.title: Kela Grimtotem
passages.text: You are a fool. A lucky fool, but still a fool.

passages.title: Kela Grimtotem
passages.text: Mark my words, I will defeat you one day soon.

passages.title: Zoltan
passages.text: With each passing day my power grows. Resistance is futile.

passages.title: Zoltan
passages.text: All hail Zoltan!

passages.title: Zoltan
passages.text: This world is doomed. Why do you continue to try so fervently?

passages.title: Elena Flutterfly
passages.text: I see you're ready for another bout in the skies. Let's take flight!

passages.title: Elena Flutterfly
passages.text: I admire your abilities in combat.

passages.title: Elena Flutterfly
passages.text: My flight has come to an end. Victory is yours this day.

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: Freeze! You've finally warmed up from our last encounter, have you? Let's change that.

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: You show no mercy. I like you.

passages.title: Grand Master Trixxy
passages.text: You're hot stuff!

passages.title: David Kosse
passages.text: My research has helped my training regimen greatly. I will defeat you this time.

passages.title: David Kosse
passages.text: I see you've worked on your routine as well.

passages.title: David Kosse
passages.text: Perhaps my research is not as complete as I thought.

passages.title: Deiza Plaguehorn
passages.text: You have not yet turned to the true path of undeath. Perhaps another battle will show you the way.

passages.title: Deiza Plaguehorn
passages.text: You will see the path in time.

passages.title: Deiza Plaguehorn
passages.text: Perhaps undeath is not the answer...

passages.title: Kortas Darkhammer
passages.text:
I hear that you fought my fool of a brother. He lost, eh?

Looks like this is my time to shine!

passages.title: Kortas Darkhammer
passages.text: How do you have such a strong team?

passages.title: Kortas Darkhammer
passages.text: You're no better than Durin. In it for the glory. Pah!

passages.title: Everessa
passages.text: I believe I'm figuring out the secrets of this place. Soon I will be unstoppable!

passages.title: Everessa
passages.text: I see you have secrets of your own.

passages.title: Durin Darkhammer
passages.text: My time under the Firelord has prepared me fer anything. Nothing you can throw at me will deter me!

passages.title: Durin Darkhammer
passages.text: What realm spawned a fighter of your caliber?

passages.title: Durin Darkhammer
passages.text: I'll defeat ye if it's the last thing I ever do. I haven't come this far fer nothin'!

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text:
The master tamers around the Eastern Kingdoms have been talking about you. You think yourself unstoppable? You believe that you are the true grand master?

Come, then, <name>. I await you in Deadwind Pass. Come, and know the crushing defeat that's always been yours.

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text: Your power is not like the others'...

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text: I have an eternity to train. I will defeat you!

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text: You wish to face me again? You will regret this decision!

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text: You are powerful beyond my own belief.

passages.title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
passages.text: You continue to reveal your strategies to me. Eventually, your defeat will be certain.

passages.title: A Tamer's Homecoming
passages.text: Yer ready to enter the full circuit of pet battlin', matey. Go back to yer trainer, Mish Burnhep, in Stormwind, and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

passages.title: A Tamer's Homecoming
passages.text: I'm so proud of you, <name>. You're ready for the big time!

passages.title: A Tamer's Homecoming
passages.text: If you beat me, then you must be ready for da big time! Go talk to Varzok in Orgrimmar.

passages.title: A Tamer's Homecoming
passages.text: Well done, <name>. You are finally prepared to truly come into your own as a tamer.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
passages.text:
You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying.

There are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath.

You must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text:
I've seen the likes of you before. A young, naive tamer that thinks that they deserve victory handed to them on a silver platter.

Well no more! I will be your reckoning, <class>. I, Bloodknight Antari of Shadowmoon Valley, await the chance to show you how it feels to be obliterated in battle.

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text: I don't believe it...

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text: Impossible! I cannot lose!

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
passages.text:
You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying.

There are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath.

You must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

passages.title: Nicki Tinytech
passages.text: According to my calculations, I have a 32.333% chance of victory. I'll take it!

passages.title: Nicki Tinytech
passages.text: I may have made a mistake somewhere...

passages.title: Nicki Tinytech
passages.text: I forgot to carry the 1!

passages.title: Ras'an
passages.text: You want to fight again? I think I've gotten better!

passages.title: Ras'an
passages.text: If I win, will you take me to visit Stormwind?

passages.title: Ras'an
passages.text: Nice work!

passages.title: Narrok
passages.text: I wish to do battle once more. These young ones need to grow stronger.

passages.title: Narrok
passages.text: You are a worthy adversary.

passages.title: Narrok
passages.text: It would seem that these younglings still have a lot of work to do before they are at full strength. Thank you.

passages.title: Morulu The Elder
passages.text: I have learned much since our last encounter. Do you wish to test your skills once more?

passages.title: Morulu The Elder
passages.text: You are truly wise beyond your years.

passages.title: Morulu The Elder
passages.text: Even I continue to learn from each passing day.

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text: You capitalized on my mistake last time and emerged victorious. This time, you will not be so fortunate, <race>.

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text: Your performance is astonishing.

passages.title: Grand Master Antari
passages.text: You are a fool for thinking yourself better than me. I will crush you, I swear it!

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text:
In my opinion, my fellow tamers have been far too lenient on your training.

True pet taming requires militaristic discipline. I shall honor you with the pleasure of seeing firsthand what that discipline can produce.

Come to the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown and see firsthand what you could become!

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text: Perhaps other methods may be useful in certain cases.

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text: I was wrong about you, <name>. You've earned my respect as one of the finest adversaries I've ever faced. Don't go and think that I'll let you defeat me again next time, though!

passages.title: Beegle Blastfuse
passages.text:
One of my chickens flew for just a moment yesterday, I swear. We're finally hitting the big time!

Oh, you'd like to battle again?

passages.title: Beegle Blastfuse
passages.text: We still don't have sustained flight, though.

passages.title: Beegle Blastfuse
passages.text: One day, when we're flying high above you, you'll be the loser!

passages.title: Nearly Headless Jacob
passages.text:
Time and time again you defy my wisdom. What is it that brings you back to these woods?

Ah, you wish to do battle once more. Very well then.

passages.title: Nearly Headless Jacob
passages.text: Your intentions are clear.

passages.title: Nearly Headless Jacob
passages.text: Your risk has paid its due reward. Now begone!

passages.title: Okrut Dragonwaste
passages.text: You dare interrupt our work? Then you must battle me again! Take out your pets, and I'll give you a taste of Hellscream's wrath!

passages.title: Okrut Dragonwaste
passages.text: You...fool.

passages.title: Okrut Dragonwaste
passages.text: I dare you to continue to fight the inevitable. Dragons will once again serve our purposes, and you will fall to my hand in a pet battle. I swear on the Warchief's mantle that it will be so!

passages.title: Gutretch
passages.text: Me like fighting you. You not so easy like the others. We fight again?

passages.title: Gutretch
passages.text: <Gutretch stares at you blankly.>

passages.title: Gutretch
passages.text: Me like fighting you, even if me lose.

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text: The rebel <class> comes once again to test <his/her> might again that of a Grand Master. Your bravery will be your undoing this time!

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text: You are a true fighter at heart. I respect that.

passages.title: Grand Master Payne
passages.text: I applaud your tactics, but despise your victory. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Battle Pet Trainers: Pandaria
passages.text:
Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!

There are four trainers that you must now defeat: Ziggy the Flightless in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.

If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text:
You have fought hard and well against the trainers of Azeroth. Even the grand masters have fallen to your cunning tactics.

I now await you in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, for you have earned the privilege to face me in battle. Come, <name>, and let us see if you have what it takes to defeat me.

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text: I have heard much about your techniques. Hopefully that does not alter the outcome of our bout.

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text: You have emerged victorious. Continue your training and find challenges in other trainers like yourself. The journey is never truly complete.

passages.title: Grand Master Hyuna
passages.text: You seek to do battle once more? Very well, it will strengthen me to better protect the sacred sites of my people.

passages.title: Grand Master Hyuna
passages.text: You are a noble fighter.

passages.title: Grand Master Hyuna
passages.text: You are very strong. Will you lend your skills to my efforts?

passages.title: Grand Master Mo'ruk
passages.text: This time I'm gonna do the beating! You watch!

passages.title: Grand Master Mo'ruk
passages.text: No! Me win!

passages.title: Grand Master Mo'ruk
passages.text: Next time you lose. I'm gonna beatcha!

passages.title: Grand Master Nishi
passages.text: My pets continue to grow in strength thanks to the fertile land we train on. You don't stand a chance!

passages.title: Grand Master Nishi
passages.text: You're good, I'll give you that.

passages.title: Grand Master Nishi
passages.text: Wow! I'm not the only one that's been training!

passages.title: Grand Master Yon
passages.text: If you think I am going to let you walk away with another victory in hand, you are sorely mistaken. This time, I will stand over you as the superior trainer!

passages.title: Grand Master Yon
passages.text: You fight well, for a <race>.

passages.title: Grand Master Yon
passages.text: Fine. Victory is yours once more. Begone, I have much preparation to do before we meet again.

passages.title: Grand Master Shu
passages.text: You venture into the heart of the wastes to face me again, only to suffer defeat at the hands of a true grand master. Noble, but foolish.

passages.title: Grand Master Shu
passages.text: Perhaps your bravery is not as foolish as I had thought.

passages.title: Grand Master Shu
passages.text: In all my time as a grand master I've never faced one as determined as you. The others were right about you. You are a force to be reckoned with.

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text: You wish to test yourself against me once more? Very well, let us fight.

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text: The journey to greatness is never complete.

passages.title: Grand Master Aki
passages.text: You are stronger and your skills more refined. Your journey continues.

passages.title: The Empress' Gambit
passages.text:
Grand Empress Shek'zeer has finally lost her patience with us. We have learned of an enormous army, massing in the shadows of the Heart of Fear, with orders to crush Klaxxi'vess.

We have been fortunate to hold out this long, but we cannot survive a siege of this scale.

Wakener, you have been invaluable to our efforts. Come, take your place on the field among we paragons.

I will see you on the battlefield!

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
passages.text:
You have defeated Northrend's finest tamers, but you need more preparation before you are ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Ready yourself and hone your skills by defeating these elite tamers: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.

Once you have triumphed over them, you will be ready to journey to Pandaria to face the ultimate challenge.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
passages.text:
Northrend has fallen to your hand, but you are not yet ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Defeat these tamers to harden your will for the coming challenges: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.

Only by defeating them will you be ready to journey to Pandaria.

passages.title: Doubt Begins To Surface
passages.text: The Alliance... so many airships. How can we possibly fight them all? I... don't feel... well...

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text:
You think yourself ready to challenge Pandaria? You truly believe that you can defeat the most powerful tamers in all of Azeroth?

I shall be the judge of that notion, <race>. Face me atop the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum, and we shall see if you are truly ready.

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text: I admire your passion, young one.

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text: I have been proven wrong. You are prepared to face my greaters.

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text: I see the triumphant tamer returns to again test <himself/herself> against me. Very well. I accept your challenge.

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text: Defeat is but a path to success.

passages.title: Grand Master Obalis
passages.text: By defeating me, I grow stronger. I urge you to be wary during our next encounter.

passages.title: Brok
passages.text: I do not yet understand the plight of these creatures well enough to help them sufficiently. Perhaps another battle would strengthen our bond?

passages.title: Brok
passages.text: Battle me for the good of all of Mount Hyjal.

passages.title: Brok
passages.text: Even in defeat I feel closer to my pets. Thank you for a worthy skirmish.

passages.title: Bordin Steadyfist
passages.text: The natives have taught me the strength of the earth. I know it's unending endurance. Let us battle once more, and you'll see that I'm tougher than ever!

passages.title: Bordin Steadyfist
passages.text: You think you can handle me?

passages.title: Bordin Steadyfist
passages.text: No, no, I just messed up. How about another go?

passages.title: Goz Banefury
passages.text: The power of twilight flows through me. I am a god! You have no hope of defeating me!

passages.title: Goz Banefury
passages.text: Pathetic <race>. Doomed to die powerless to the true rulers of this world.

passages.title: Goz Banefury
passages.text: You fight with the wrath of my masters. Perhaps you and I aren't so different.

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: Let's see...where to send you next...

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: Word of your skill is spreading. I suggest you return to your trainer, Audrey Burnhep, for further guidance.

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: Let's see...where to send you next...

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Varzok in Orgrimmar and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: I've been at work preparing your next set of challenges, <name>. Let us see if you are prepared...

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text:
Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste!

Taran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get.

We were on our way to Dawn's Blossom to deliver our brew when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost!

You want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.

passages.title: Priorities!
passages.text: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: Word of your skill is spreading. I suggest you return to your trainer, Varzok, for further guidance.

passages.title: The Returning Champion
passages.text: I think I know just the right place to test you next.

passages.title: Exceeding Expectations
passages.text: Run off to your trainer, Audrey Burnhep, in Stormwind. Perhaps she can find you more...worthwhile...challenges.

passages.title: Exceeding Expectations
passages.text: You really beat Grand Master Antari? Wow! I'm going to have to find you some really tough tamers to fight!

passages.title: Exceeding Expectations
passages.text: Run off to your trainer, Varzok, in Orgrimmar. Perhaps he can find you more... worthwhile... challenges.

passages.title: Exceeding Expectations
passages.text: There is only one place to test you next.

passages.title: A Brief Reprieve
passages.text: Well done, for an <race>. Now, get back to Orgrimmar and talk to that brute Varzok. Maybe he can point you somewhere very far away from my family.

passages.title: A Brief Reprieve
passages.text: I think I know the next step you ought to take.

passages.title: A Brief Reprieve
passages.text:
Well done, well done indeed! If you would, please report to Miss Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.

Oh, and send her my regards. She's a beautiful young woman that could benefit from the company of an accomplished fighter such as myself.

passages.title: A Brief Reprieve
passages.text: Payne asked you to court me for him, didn't he? When is he ever going to learn?

passages.title: The Triumphant Return
passages.text: You are now prepared as your trainer instructed. Travel back to Stormwind and have words with Audrey Burnhep. She will guide you further.

passages.title: The Triumphant Return
passages.text: I take it you met Obalis? He's a wonderful fellow, once you get past his rough exterior.

passages.title: The Triumphant Return
passages.text: You are now prepared as your trainer instructed. Travel back to Orgrimmar and have words with Varzok. He will guide you further.

passages.title: The Triumphant Return
passages.text: You are now prepared for a true test of your skill in battle. Are you up to it?

passages.title: Audrey Burnhep
passages.text:
I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, <name>. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!
<race>eport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

passages.title: Grand Master Zusshi
passages.text: I knew you would return to face me once more. Let us see who is truly wiser in the ways of battle.

passages.title: Grand Master Zusshi
passages.text: Despite my wisdom, you manage to surprise me.

passages.title: Grand Master Zusshi
passages.text: You are indeed superior. If you would pardon me, I must consult the lake for guidance in my defeat.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
passages.text: <name>, I need you to assemble a cunning group and venture forth into the depths of Scarlet Halls. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put a stop to Flameweaver Koegler's book-burning ways.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. Just the thought of him burning up that beautiful library makes me shudder. Your friends will appreciate the speed with which you dispatched him.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Scholomance. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Scholomance of Darkmaster Gandling's evil presence.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
passages.text: <name>, you've done a great service. May the skeletons of the dead remain peaceful now that Gandling no longer seeks to disturb their slumber.

passages.title: Audrey Burnhep
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>! My name is Audrey Burnhep. I've been hearing quite a lot about you recently. You're becoming quite the tamer!

You should come speak with me in Stormwind. I have connections with some of the finest tamers in all of Azeroth, and I can help you grow even more!

passages.title: Audrey Burnhep
passages.text: Ah, you're <name>. Splendid! Let's get to work then, shall we?

passages.title: Varzok
passages.text:
Lok'tar, <name>. My name is Varzok. I have heard much your accomplishments as a tamer recently, and I would like to introduce you to trainers around Azeroth so that you may further hone your skills.

Please speak with me in Orgrimmar so that we may begin.

passages.title: Varzok
passages.text:
You must be <name>. Well met. I am Varzok.

I will serve as your contact from here on out.

passages.title: A Celestial Task
passages.text:
Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria.

They watch you as well.

Their knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power.

You may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task.

The Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger. First, we must all defend the Vale. Then, we can turn our eyes to the Celestials themselves.

passages.title: A Celestial Task
passages.text: The Vale is safer now, thanks to you. Now, you must help the Celestials.

passages.title: A Celestial Task
passages.text:
Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria.

They watch you as well.

Their knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power.

You may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task.

The Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger. First, we must all defend the Vale. Then, we can turn our eyes to the Celestials themselves.

passages.title: A Celestial Task
passages.text: The Vale is safer now, thanks to you. Now, you must help the Celestials.

passages.title: Once in a Hundred Lifetimes
passages.text:
The time has come, wakener.

The council's power will combine to bring an end to the corrupted empress.

This ritual has not been witnessed in one hundred of your kind's lifetimes - and never by an outsider.

In exchange for your deeds on our behalf, I invite you to behold this great moment in our history.

passages.title: Once in a Hundred Lifetimes
passages.text:
Your arrival is timely, wakener.

Our ritual is underway.

passages.title: Stag Mastery
passages.text:
I always was a fan of a good stag hunt. Stags are tough, fast, and territorial.

They may be plant eaters but they can give any hunter a run for his money.

East of here is a whole mess of Wilderland Stags just waiting for a hunter like yourself to give 'em a good run.

Happy hunting.

passages.title: Stag Mastery
passages.text: How goes the hunt?

passages.title: Stag Mastery
passages.text: I haven't seen stag hunting this good since Ashenvale.

passages.title: Children of the Water
passages.text:
We are all children of the water here in the Valley of the Four Winds. It nourishes us, it grows our vegetables, it brings us life.

Some creatures, however, drink too deeply from the water. They grow too large, and must be eliminated before they cause havoc to those around them.

I am but a simple stonecarver. You, on the other hand...

passages.title: Children of the Water
passages.text:
Let this be a lesson to you: don't drink too much of the water.

Why do you think we have such a big brewery?

passages.title: Pristine Monument Ledger
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition. Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

passages.title: So, You Wanted to Test Daily Quests?
passages.text: You wanna test dailies? Well alright then.

passages.title: Shackles of the Past
passages.text:
The mogu are a bunch of right bastards!

They enslaved the pandaren who worked these caves even after their death. Ye' gotta go free their spirits! It's just not right.

Be careful though... so much trauma, they don't know what's a friend and what's an enemy. So they'll probably fight back.

passages.title: Shackles of the Past
passages.text: Ye' did good work out there. It's not right seein' the dead unable to rest like that.

passages.title: Priorities, People!
passages.text:
When I ordered the excavation of the tunnel to the northwest, I thought we'd find something useful. Gold, iron... anything!

Instead, we found mogu artifacts, and I get a bunch of dwarves from the Explorers' League to baby-sit.

I hear from the soldiers that there's trouble in the mines. I have orders from Wrynn that I have to support the Explorers' League, but I can't spare any troops. Can you get down there and find out what's going on?

passages.title: Priorities, People!
passages.text: Oi! We got a right nasty problem here. Kicked the hornet's nest. Except these are mogu ghost hornets with a mean streak a bloody mile wide!

passages.title: It Is A Mystery
passages.text:
There's somethin' down there that was spookin' the workers. Some kind o' anomaly... looks like a ghost, or a magic spell... like nothing I've ever seen.

I did manage to get a reading on it and put together this device to try to track it down. The display on the device will let you know roughly how close you are. 

Once you get close enough, you can use it to draw out the anomaly and get rid of it for good!

passages.title: It Is A Mystery
passages.text: We need to get that anomaly gone so our workers won't be spooked!

passages.title: It Is A Mystery
passages.text: Good work! Now maybe the workers can get through a day without fillin' their britches!

passages.title: Legacy of Ogudei
passages.text:
The ruins which we are occupying were built by Ogudei - an ancient mogu ruler. We know little about who he was, though the rise of the spirits in this area seems to indicate that it was related to spirit binding.

When you destroy these spirits, a small amount of their essence will remain in this world. Bring it to us - we will analyze it and hopefully learn more about Ogudei's history - and his power.

passages.title: Legacy of Ogudei
passages.text: You'll need to destroy the spirits to collect their essence. Go to it.

passages.title: Legacy of Ogudei
passages.text: Good, good. We'll begin our research post-haste.

passages.title: The Spirit Trap
passages.text:
In the ruins there are a bunch of right nasty blue crystals. Look at 'em the wrong way and bloody angry ghosts run out at ya.

I'm gonna be needing ye' to go in and clear some of them out so we can get our people back to work.

passages.title: The Spirit Trap
passages.text: Those things are nasty! Thanks for takin' care of 'em for us.

passages.title: Death on Two Legs
passages.text:
The Alliance has made landfall. If we do not defeat them here, any hope of a Horde presence on this continent is lost.

Go to the battlefield south of here and slay Alliance you find.

Show them how any Horde who still stands on two legs will be the death of ten Alliance!

passages.title: Death on Two Legs
passages.text: The Alliance must find no purchase on these shores.

passages.title: Death on Two Legs
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I see your time in this land has hardened your resolve and sharpened your skills.

passages.title: Don't Try So Hard - DEPRECATED
passages.text:
Ah, a <class>! I guess you'll do.

My spies tell me there are Alliance spies sneaking around outside the fortress. But they are just... so... bad at it! I mean come on! Show a little pride in your work or something.

Go kill a bunch of 'em as a lesson to the others.

Here, take this batch of my latest Spy Stinker formula. If you can't see the spies just start tossing these outside the walls of the fortress to the south and you should flush them out.

passages.title: Tear It Up
passages.text:
The Alliance may be cowardly, but they are not fools. Their assault would be formidable, if it were directed at lesser creatures.

To sustain a siege and put pressure on our troops they are air dropping in supplies to support their ground forces.

Search the beaches and docks to the south for any airdropped supplies and smash them.

Let the Alliance see their food and ammunition destroyed before their eyes and despair.

passages.title: Tear It Up
passages.text: Never rely on a weapon that requires more than your own strength to wield.

passages.title: Tear It Up
passages.text: Just remember, the weapon of choice is not always the weapon with the longest range or heaviest amount of damage. In the end, the best weapon is the weapon that works every time.

passages.title: All Dead, All Dead
passages.text:
Our Warchief has dispatched me to these shores to deal with this pitiful Alliance threat.

These humans and their allies have proven to be very dependent on their leaders. No initiative of their own.

As you walk the battlefield today look to the Alliance ships off our southern shores. Find their captains.

Slay them.

For the Horde!

passages.title: All Dead, All Dead
passages.text: Every weapon has its function.

passages.title: All Dead, All Dead
passages.text: It is not enough to rob the Alliance of their leaders. We must warn those who would aspire to leadership the cost of such ambition.

passages.title: Another One Bites the Dust
passages.text:
The Alliance have planted themselves off our southern coast and continue to pepper our ground forces with cannon fire. Let us see how great their siege is without such support.

Board the enemy vessels and destroy their reserve ammunition. This will take the teeth out of their bite.

passages.title: Another One Bites the Dust
passages.text: For the Horde!

passages.title: Another One Bites the Dust
passages.text: Ah! Look at them burn. These new Alliance craft require more to destroy them permanently however. I am sure they will have those fires out in a day or two.

passages.title: Worker Harassment
passages.text:
Our goblin friends do not have the grasp of strategy necessary to win a long term engagement, I'm afraid.

The key to eliminating any permanent establishment is to attack their ability to replenish their troops and to rebuild.

In this case, that means taking out their Peasants. Kill them, and you weaken the foundation. The rest of the keep is bound to crumble.

passages.title: Worker Harassment
passages.text:
Good work. That should slow them down by a few days, at least.

You don't win the war by playing the short game, friend. Trust me, this is the right strategy.

passages.title: Hero Killer
passages.text:
There are some situations in which taking out one of their soldiers is more important than killing hundreds.

They've deployed some of their heroes to the battlefield to help rally their defenders. Not only will killing them soften their defense, it will also leave their morale crippled.

So go, take one down for me. You can handle it.

passages.title: Hero Killer
passages.text:
Cut off the head, and the body will fall.

... Unless you're forsaken, I guess. I realize I should probably stop using that saying now that I am.

passages.title: Work Order: Fuel
passages.text:
Our fuel supplies are running low. Without fuel we won't be able to operate the machinery that's building this place. They might even expect me to start helping them build!

I was not built for manual labor! See these nails?! I just had them done!

Get down to the refinery and get this fuel order filled! Hurry! They were fitting me for a tool-belt this morning. It didn't even match my outfit!

passages.title: Work Order: Fuel
passages.text: More fuel huh? Is her "loveliness" afraid she might have to do a little more than sit around lookin' pretty?

passages.title: Work Order: Lumber
passages.text:
Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!"

I work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here!

Oh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!

passages.title: Work Order: Lumber
passages.text:
Good for nothin' huh?! I'm busting my rump down here!

Maybe her "uselessness" would like to come down here and haul this lumber herself!

passages.title: Work Order: Iron
passages.text:
When they said they found some amazing rocks in that mine I envisioned diamonds. Everyone knows all mines have diamonds, silly! At the very least rubies!

Instead, all I got was this strange iron! What am I supposed to do with this?

Oh well, no one said this job would be glamorous. I just do what I can to add a little class.

We just got another work order for iron. Go see Daxil down near Oregrind's Dig and get it filled pronto!

passages.title: Work Order: Iron
passages.text:
Is she still complaining about diamonds and rubies? We found something better than diamonds down here!

This ore is special. It has power!

passages.title: Power Metal
passages.text:
<Daxil narrows her eyes and speaks in a hushed tone.>

Sometimes we dig too deep, <class>. Sometimes, we uncover something so horrible we wish we hadn't started diggin'...

Just kidding! I mean, don't get me wrong, we did find something unexpected. The ore we're finding down there is not your average run-of-the-mill iron.

There is just one problem; Shale Spiders! We're struggling to keep these orders filled.

Maybe you can lend us a hand?

passages.title: Power Metal
passages.text: Did you happen to find anything sparkly while you were down there?

passages.title: Power Metal
passages.text:
Did they manage to find anything useful down there? Maybe an emerald or an opal? Is it too much to ask for a little bit of effort?!

Nevermind! I'll make sure this shipment gets where it's goin'.

passages.title: We Will Rock You
passages.text:
The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor.

adventurer, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads!

Slay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails.

For the King!

passages.title: We Will Rock You
passages.text: Well done, soldier. That should help keep the horde in check.

passages.title: A Kind of Magic
passages.text:
Greetings adventurer! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities.

I promise it is mostly harmless to its users.

When you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location.

See you in the field... as it were.

passages.title: Under Pressure
passages.text:
The Horde are consumed by pride and will fight to the death without a second thought.

We need to find a way to break their will that does not involve massive loss of our numbers.

Look for the Horde supplies along the coastline and near their ships. Smash their supplies.

Nothing breaks the will of a defender like seeing their hope of food go up in a puff of smoke.

When you are done, find Sully behind enemy lines. He has the next task for you.

passages.title: Under Pressure
passages.text:
Thanks to your actions, the Horde knows it cannot feed its troops.

The timeframe they can withstand a siege is greatly reduced and their morale is going to start suffering soon.

We just need to keep applying pressure.

passages.title: Hammer to Fall
passages.text:
It looks like the Horde thinks they can hide behind their heavy hitting mooks.

The mooks are tough, powerful, and dumber than an ogre with a hangover.

Go down there and bring the hammer of the Alliance fury down on them!

passages.title: Hammer to Fall
passages.text: Thank you soldier. That should teach the Horde that it will take more than a couple of mooks to scare us away.

passages.title: Attack! Move!
passages.text:
Sure, they've got about plenty of grunts out there, pounding on our door, waiting to cut our heads off.

I'm not worried about grunts. But they've got shamans and raiders, too. The shamans use their magic to empower the grunts, and the raiders are fast and specialize in taking out our buildings.

I need you to get out there and kill some of those shamans and raiders.

Go! Attack! Move!

passages.title: Attack! Move!
passages.text: Good work, soldier. Without those shamans, I don't think they'll have much luck breaking down our defenses.

passages.title: Supply Block
passages.text:
The Horde decided to put goblins in charge of their logistics. And where you have goblins, you have carelessly placed explosives.

Scouts have reported that they have their supplies in carts that also contain demolisher ammunition. Look at those crates the wrong way, and they'll blow sky high. 

With enough Horde resources destroyed, we'll put a time limit on their attack and save lives. So go and take out those carts!

passages.title: Supply Block
passages.text:
Without those supplies, they won't be able to support bringing more warriors in the fight. If they can't bring in more warriors, we have a great shot at holding out.

For today, at least.

passages.title: Hero Killer
passages.text:
Look, you're tough. Tougher than the rest of the men and women I've got here. Which means I need you for a special mission.

The Horde is throwing their best against us. Heroes of their armies - Blademasters, Tauren Chieftans, you name it.

I need you to go take one out. It'll be a huge blow, not just to their offensive but also to morale.

passages.title: Hero Killer
passages.text: I know it wasn't easy, but you did it. Good work. You've got my respect, soldier.

passages.title: The Only Good Goblin...
passages.text:
The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable, <class>. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation.

This is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance.

Destroy them!

passages.title: The Only Good Goblin...
passages.text: Excellent work, <class>! Eventually we will wipe the Horde from this continent.

passages.title: Two Step Program
passages.text:
Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there, <class>.

Rumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict.

Imagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction.

The first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.

passages.title: Two Step Program
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>! Now the forest can begin its regrowth process. From all death comes new life, and a new opportunity to protect it.

passages.title: Circle of Life
passages.text:
We should attempt to offset the destruction being wrought on this continent as much as possible. For every tree they destroy, we will plant a new one!

Take these seeds and begin the regrowth process, <name>.

Do not linger for too long though. Nature is unpredictable, and no doubt the anger and hate exuding from Domination Point has seeped into the ground.

I cannot guarantee that the plant that springs from these seeds will not be hostile.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text:
Along with the trap, you get some advice on tiger hunting:

Tigers are gluttonous creatures, and large game is hard to come by in this jungle. If you wish to tempt the most elder cats out of their hiding places, you may do so with a meal.

Just on the other side of the Serpent's Spine, you will find a herd of yaks. Slay them, bring their meat to the jungle's edge, set up your trap, and wait.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text: This looks like an ideal spot for a tiger trap.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text: You lay the meat out atop the trap, then turn your eyes toward the jungle...

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text:
Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting:

Crabs are strange, primordial creatures, with wildly different motivations than you or I.

Small crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the large ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell.

The Unga villagers to the southeast allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text: This looks like a good place to catch a crab.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text: You spread out the decaying fish, prepare the crate, then turn your eyes toward the beach...

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text:
Along with the trap, you get some advice on tiger hunting:

Tigers are gluttons, and big game is hard to come by in this jungle. If you want to tempt the elder cats out of their hiding places, you need a tempting meal.

Just on the other side of the Serpent's Spine, you can find a herd of yaks. Kill them, bring their meat to the jungle's edge, set up your trap, and wait.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text: This looks like an ideal spot for a tiger trap.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
passages.text: You lay the meat out atop the trap, then turn your eyes toward the jungle...

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text:
Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting:

Crabs are strange, old creatures, with different motivations than us.

Small crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the big ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell.

The Unga villagers to the southwest allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text: This looks like a good place to catch a crab.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
passages.text: You spread out the decaying fish, prepare the crate, then turn your eyes toward the beach...

passages.title: Darkmoon Pet Battle!
passages.text: Are you prepared to test the mettle of your pets...?

passages.title: Darkmoon Pet Battle!
passages.text: My, my. Well done!

passages.title: Darkmoon Pet Battle!
passages.text: I must say, good show!

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text:
The ancient crane is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text:
It only took one to capture the beast, but it will take many more to truly defeat it.

Speak to me again when you have gathered enough allies. We shall test the grace of the crane against the might of the Horde.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text:
The elder cat is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text:
It only took one to capture the beast, but it will take many more to truly defeat it.

Speak to me again when you have gathered enough allies. We shall test the ferocity of the tiger against the might of the Horde.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text:
The colossal crab is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text:
It only took one to capture the beast, but it will take many more to truly defeat it.

Speak to me again when you have gathered enough allies. We shall test the resilience of the crab against the might of the Horde.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text:
The ancient crane is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
passages.text:
It might have taken just one <race> to capture this beast, but it will take many more to put it down.

Gather up some friends, then come and speak with me again. We'll pit the grace of the crane against the glory of the Alliance!

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text:
The elder cat is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
passages.text:
It might have taken just one <race> to capture this beast, but it will take many more to put it down.

Gather up some friends, then come and speak with me again. We'll pit the power of the tiger against the glory of the Alliance!

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text:
The colossal crab is alive, but stunned.

You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
passages.text:
It might have taken just one <race> to capture this beast, but it will take many more to put it down.

Gather up some friends, then come and speak with me again. We'll pit the stamina of the crab against the glory of the Alliance!

passages.title: A Shabby New Face
passages.text:
A strange fellow in a pointy hat showed up this morning trying to sell some kinda special seeds. Claimed they were magic.

I welcome a little competition - business is business, after all - but this gentleman had a certain... shabby look to him. Oh, and he stunk somethin' FIERCE.

Would you check up on him, just to make sure he's on the level? He's over there by Jian Ironpaw, making a meal out of the samples.

passages.title: A Shabby New Face
passages.text:
AUGHM... nomf... -slurp- mmmf...

<Barnaby looks up from the table, revealing a tangled beard dotted with melon seeds. Juices rush down his chin as he greets you.>

Mmf... -cough- A customer! Hello! Name's Fletcher. Barnaby Fletcher - nice to meet you!

<He wipes a hand on his robe before extending it, still visibly sticky and flecked with pulp.>

passages.title: Ancient Guardians
passages.text:
Before the mogu overwhelmed our scouting party, we found relics scattered amongst the ruins to the north.

I would like to collect some samples, but the mogu's terracotta watchdogs are too much for us to handle.

If you could clear the area of their presence, we will be able to resume our work.

passages.title: Ancient Guardians
passages.text: I am quite keen to understand the mogu's magic.

passages.title: Ancient Guardians
passages.text: Ah! Well done! With the guardians gone, we should be able to excavate these ruins safely.

passages.title: Anger Remains
passages.text:
From the looks o' our initial survey, this entire area is humming with residual sha energy.

You know what ta do, <name>. Destroy any last traces ye can find o' the stuff!

passages.title: A Kind of Magic - DEPRECATED
passages.text:
Greetings <..your name here..>!

Do you find war to be constantly challenging your survivability? Is today's Horde proving to be too much for your armor?

Well, then look no further than the all new "Siege-o-Matic 4000".

Try it out the latest prototype today! Just look for Scout-o-Matics <near the Wolf Kennel>, <near the Horde Base entrance>, and <atop the Horde Battlements>.

passages.title: Mystery Meatloaf
passages.text:
We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others.

Between you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does!

We need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here...

I got it! Mystery Meatloaf!

passages.title: Mystery Meatloaf
passages.text: What do ya got for me now?

passages.title: Mystery Meatloaf
passages.text:
I have standards ya know! I'm a chef, not a magician!

The only mystery here is how Duke thinks he'll pull this over on everyone else!

passages.title: Dangers of Za'Tual
passages.text:
<name>, what I ask of you is little short of genocide, but it is a task that must be done.

Find trolls within their town or on the beach and slay them, for the good of us all.

passages.title: Dangers of Za'Tual
passages.text: Much blood was spilled this day. It is on my hands, <name>, not yours.

passages.title: The Skumblade Threat
passages.text:
Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations.

Thin their numbers, <name>. Once the Horde takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.

passages.title: The Skumblade Threat
passages.text:
One day, this island will belong to the Horde. I can only hope that it will be free of saurok before then.

<Aethas sneers.>

At least they attack the Alliance, too.

passages.title: Saur Loser
passages.text:
Inside the Beast Pens you will encounter some of the most skilled beast tamers in the Zandalari military. They are trained to kill with axe, beast, and claw. This is where they build their cavalry.

We need you to kill any Zandalari you find in there before they can get their mounted monstrosities out into the open battlefield.

passages.title: Saur Loser
passages.text: A trained Zandalari beastcaller with a mount unleashed on the battlefield can kill twenty times their number. Your preemptive attack has saved many lives. Thank you!

passages.title: Nalak the Storm Lord
passages.text: [PH] Kill Nalak [Description]

passages.title: Heinous Sacrifice
passages.text:
The Zandalari perform heinous rites against our people! They must be stopped!

Delve into the heart of the Za'Tual and destroy their altars.

passages.title: Heinous Sacrifice
passages.text: This effort should quell their obscene sacrifices for a time.

passages.title: Heinous Sacrifice
passages.text: I could feel the magic of their altars dissipating even here, <class>.

passages.title: Pterrible Ptorment
passages.text:
The Zandalari treat their skyscreamer pets as little more than scuttling vermin, bending them to their will with violence and torment.

I can hear one writhing in pain at their hands.

Find the tormented skyscreamer within Za'Tual and help it break free of its captors.

passages.title: Pterrible Ptorment
passages.text: Have you found the skyscreamer?

passages.title: Pterrible Ptorment
passages.text: It what?! It killed its master? Wonderful. These skyscreamers  have more fight in them than I realized. Thank you for helping free the beast, <race> - it is one less threat to the Horde, and one more for the Zandalari.

passages.title: Dark Offerings
passages.text:
The spirtibinders of the Zandalari perform sacrificial rites to appease the loa and their vile gods. These dark rituals involve the sacrifice of our people.

Destroy any offerings you can find among their tents in Za'Tual and perhaps we can stall the sacrifices.

passages.title: Dark Offerings
passages.text: I truly hope this helps slow them down. The sacrifices proceed at an alarming rate.

passages.title: Dark Offerings
passages.text: The tide of blood is slowed, at least for a time. Thank you for your efforts in stalling the sacrifices, <class>.

passages.title: Ashes of the Enemy
passages.text:
The mogu here at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead.

We cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors.

Take this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find.

We will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.

passages.title: Ashes of the Enemy
passages.text: The dead should be allowed to rest.

passages.title: Ashes of the Enemy
passages.text: Their dead shall rise no more, thanks to you, <name>. Excellent work.

passages.title: Stone Cold
passages.text:
Our assault on the Court of Bones continues. Our progress remains slow, but measurable.

Unfortunately, we've received several reports of stone quilen statues coming to life without warning. I can't have these quilen threatening my research expedition.

Venture into the Court of Bones and destroy any quilen statues that you can find.

passages.title: Stone Cold
passages.text: I am glad to hear that you left the quilen in a thousand tiny pieces. You have contributed much to our war effort.

passages.title: Rise No More!
passages.text:
Have you seen the ghosts wandering the graveyard?

They are risen ancestors, the spirits of slain mogu who have been called back to this world.

When angered, they attack swiftly and silently, and their numbers increase by the day.

They do not belong here. Destroy them, and send them back beyond the grave.

passages.title: Rise No More!
passages.text: Wonderful work, <class>. This will help our offensive a great deal.

passages.title: The Call of Thunder
passages.text:
Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity.

We suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Dawnseeker Promontory.

There is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.

passages.title: The Call of Thunder
passages.text: You continue to exceed my expectations, <class>. Well done.

passages.title: The Shuddering Moor
passages.text:
There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate.

Strike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.

passages.title: The Shuddering Moor
passages.text:
You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.

Come back to me in a day's time, <class>.

passages.title: The Zandalari Colossus
passages.text: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared, <class>.

passages.title: The Zandalari Colossus
passages.text: Have you done as I asked?

passages.title: The Zandalari Colossus
passages.text:
When I give you a task, it gets handled.

Well done, <class>.

passages.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
passages.text:
There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.

As you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

passages.title: What's Inside Counts
passages.text:
I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it.

We need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good.

I've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.

passages.title: What's Inside Counts
passages.text:
So I was correct to be concerned. It's a good thing you were there to stop them before that guardian was fully infused.

Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Precious Resource
passages.text:
What we have here is too much of a good thing, <name>!

Our rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves.

I've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again.

It's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though....

Maybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.

passages.title: Precious Resource
passages.text: Were you able to get those valves tightened?

passages.title: Precious Resource
passages.text:
So I was being followed! Those dirty rotten sneaks!

I'm going to have to start planting some real nice surprises for those cowards. Surprises that will really knock 'em out!

passages.title: Dagger in the Dark
passages.text:
Shadow Hunter Vol'jin has joined a group of Kor'kron scouts on an important mission for the warchief.

Of course a proud member of the Horde such as yourself is welcome to go along, but be warned - it could get ugly.

passages.title: Dagger in the Dark
passages.text: Good ta see ya, mon. I be needin' true allies at my side for dis mission.

passages.title: Harbingers of the Loa
passages.text:
Have you heard of the loa? We do not understand all of what it is, but it seems to be a dark magic with some degree of sentience.

We do not know what power the loa might possess, but I must ask you to put a stop to their rituals, <class>.

passages.title: Harbingers of the Loa
passages.text: I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed, <name>. Your bravery was put to the test this day, and you did not fail the Horde in your task.

passages.title: De-Constructed
passages.text:
Saurok consistently test our borders, and our constructs usually fend them off. Some constructs, however, have been defeated and dragged back to Ihgaluk Crag.

I want those constructs back. No slithering lizard will steal Sunreaver property under my watch.

passages.title: De-Constructed
passages.text:
That's more like it.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Mana Manifestations
passages.text:
Manafiends are nasty creatures. Small and easy to underestimate, but deadly to our magic casters. The Kirin Tor have these pests crawling all over Violet Rise.

We will need to handle them carefully. Alone they are easily managed, but in groups they become a different challenge altogether.

Go to Violet Rise and cut down their numbers.

passages.title: Mana Manifestations
passages.text: This task will be ongoing, but you have done as a great service, <race>.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
passages.text:
We need to keep a close watch on the Kirin Tor and their day-to-day activities. Normally this would be easy. We would sneak in a spy and have them report back to us.

However, we've run into a slight problem I believe you can help us with.

The Kirin Tor perimeter wards have increased in power. It's next to impossible to get someone past their lines. If they were disabled we might be able to sneak in before they can be repaired.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
passages.text: Good work, <class>. With your help we were able to successfully sneak several spies behind enemy lines.

passages.title: To the Skies!
passages.text:
We can use the pterrorwing that you found to strike a decisive blow against the mogu. 

Their mining operation is vulnerable to attack from the air, and your pterrorwing is the only beast we have capable of flying out there.

Let me know when you are ready!

passages.title: To the Skies!
passages.text: It's time to begin your mission!

passages.title: To the Skies!
passages.text: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.

passages.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
passages.text:
Long ago, Lei Shen found a rare clutch of storm dragon eggs. One of these creatures - Nalak - was particularly brutal, and Lei Shen took it for his own.

The Thunder King's servant, Shan Bu, works to resurrect Lei Shen's dragon, Nalak.

We must defeat Shan Bu and, if we are able, prevent him from resurrecting the dragon.

passages.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
passages.text: We must defeat Shan Bu while he is exposed!

passages.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Shan Bu's fall will weaken the Mogu and your heroism will surely be remembered.

passages.title: Loa-saur
passages.text:
The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.

We need to put a stop to this.

Search the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.

We must not allow these atrocities to continue.

passages.title: Loa-saur
passages.text: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?

passages.title: The Sleepless Legion
passages.text: The Shan'ze are animating an army from the statues in the center of the isle, an army that batters our defenses day and night. Destroy any of the walking statues you see. Our defenders will greatly appreciate it.

passages.title: The Sleepless Legion
passages.text: Your efforts are appreciated.

passages.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
passages.text: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Lor'themar wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.

passages.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Thank you for the help.

passages.title: Bolstering the Defenses
passages.text:
This island holds many dangers for us. Threats loom from every side. We must defend our hold on these shores at all costs.

Perimeter wards have been placed around Dawnseeker Promontory. By default they will inflict damage, but are not fatal in their attack.

Now is not the time to be merciful, <race>. The perimeter wards need to be deadly!

Go and empower the perimeter wards surrounding our camp.

passages.title: Bolstering the Defenses
passages.text: Now that the wards have been fully armed, we can focus our attention elsewhere. Nothing will be slipping past us now!

passages.title: [PH] The Fall of Shan Bu
passages.text: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Description]

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: My scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari among the bones west of Ihgaluk Crag. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.

passages.title: Raining Bones
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Would you be willing to do the deed?

passages.title: Raining Bones
passages.text: You're a good <class> to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.

passages.title: An Unusual Tome
passages.text:
The tome appears to be written in an ornate, sprawling script that seems to rise off the pages. It vaguely resembles Demonic, but the symbols are far more elaborate than any you've ever seen.

Perhaps one of your demonic companions can tell you more.

passages.title: Made for War
passages.text:
Jaina thinks this battle will be easily won. I intend to show her how wrong she is!

The Kirin Tor brought a weapon with them that must be destroyed. The Arcane Destroyer is a large construct capable of turning the tides of war in their favor.

Destroying this monstrosity would send a very clear message to Proudmoore.

passages.title: Made for War
passages.text:
I wish I could be there to see the look on Proudmoore's face as she mourns the loss of her death machine!

We can be certain she will build another, but we have at least set her back.

passages.title: Overpowered
passages.text:
The Kirin Tor are using mana foci to empower their forces. We cannot allow this to continue.

You'll find these foci scattered around the outskirts of Violet Rise. Use this mana crystal to destroy as many as you can.

Each mana focus we destroy is another small victory for our cause.

passages.title: Overpowered
passages.text: Excellent work, <class>! It will take them days to rebuild those foci.

passages.title: Reader for the Dead Tongue
passages.text: Return to your capital city and seek out a warlock trainer who may know more about the codex.

passages.title: Reader for the Dead Tongue
passages.text: What... where in the great dark did you find this?

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text:
This book may be just the leverage we've been seeking... 

How familiar are you with the Council of the Black Harvest, <name>?

After Deathwing was defeated, six of the greatest Warlocks gathered together to teach all Warlocks advanced forms of magic stolen from our defeated foes.

Take a look at the tome beside me...

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text: Well, what did you think?

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text: You are ready to learn more...

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text:
This book may be just the leverage we've been seeking... 

How familiar are you with the Council of the Black Harvest, <name>?

After Deathwing was defeated, six of the greatest Warlocks gathered together to teach all Warlocks advanced forms of magic stolen from our defeated foes.

Take a look at the tome beside me...

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text: Well, what did you think?

passages.title: A Tale of Six Masters
passages.text: You are now ready to learn more...

passages.title: Enlistment Orders
passages.text:
After the Council returned from their journey, they passed the knowledge of what they learned to all of the Warlock sects.

However, they disappeared shortly afterwards...

<name>! The tome you possess may be just the thing we need to convince them to join us in our assault against the Alliance!

Find General Nazgrim in Domination Point and convince him of the importance of your mission.

passages.title: Enlistment Orders
passages.text:
After the Council returned from their journey, they passed the knowledge of what they learned to all of the Warlock sects.

However, they disappeared shortly afterwards...

<name>! The tome you possess may be just the thing we need to convince them to join us in our assault against the Horde!

Find Admiral Taylor in Lion's Landing and convince him of the importance of your mission.

passages.title: Hunt Helheim
passages.text:
<name>... You've heard correctly. Warchief Garrosh tasked me with tracking down this Council of the Black Harvest.

Unfortunately, I have heard word that the Alliance is ahead of us. I heard that some Human Warlock by the name of Hareem Helheim has information which will help us locate them.

Head to Lion's Landing, infiltrate their base and obtain the documents before Helheim's courier departs. Show Helheim no mercy.

passages.title: The Horde Is Family
passages.text:
This hearthstone was part of a conversation Vol'jin and I shared a long time ago.

He believes his people are in danger. I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.

Come, adventurer, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.

passages.title: The Horde Is Family
passages.text: Vol'jin has saved my life many times in the past. To see my own Kor'kron used against his people cuts deeper than I can put into words.

passages.title: The Monkey King
passages.text:
Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.

My research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.

If we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

passages.title: The Monkey King
passages.text:
You come asking for the Monkey King?

Let us see how well you ookin' sing.

Who are you, so tiny and boring?

Your cause is silly! You leave me snoring.

Three riddles I will ask,

These riddles are a task,

Finish each without pause,

And we shall see if I help your cause.

passages.title: Seek the Signal
passages.text:
The soulstone shards fuse together easily in your hands.

Strangely, no soul is stored within the stone. Instead, the stone seems to be drawing power from somewhere in Shadowmoon Valley. Looking east, you feel the power linked beyond the mountains, to the very gates of the Black Temple.

passages.title: Victorious Return
passages.text: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.

passages.title: Victorious Return
passages.text:
You found the bell! And Fanlyr teleported it to Silvermoon for study, as instructed? The Horde will put this to good use.

You have done the Horde a great service today. Lok'tar, friend!

passages.title: What's in the Box?
passages.text:
We are trying to uncover the secrets of one of the mogu artifacts Garrosh insisted we investigate. It is proving most difficult, as anyone who probes it magically is greatly affected by raw, negative emotions.

I called in the assistance of Arch-mage Aethas of the Sunreavers in the hopes that he and Rommath could crack this puzzle. They asked for you specifically - apparently you have some relevant experience?

Go to the chamber below Farstrider Square east of here and see if you can assist them.

passages.title: What's in the Box?
passages.text: This reckless use of my people by Garrosh is becoming intolerable. If you had not been here to assist I dread to think what might have happened.

passages.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
passages.text:
You want to stop the Divine Bell? We need the mallet first.

You want the mallet? We need to be friends first.

You want to be friends? We need a Metal brew first. 

You want a Metal brew? You need to go to the Shrine of Fellowship first. 

You want to go to the Shrine of Fellowship? Great! It's in the Jade Forest southeast of the Tian Monastery.

Ring the bell and get the Monkey King some brew while there. Oh... you may have to fight for it.

passages.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
passages.text: You have the Metal Brew?

passages.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
passages.text:
The Metal Brew is strong and lasting, a brew to be shared with friends after a battle.

Emperor Shaohao and his Monkey King had many a round in our day. Many battles, and many good friends.

passages.title: The Third Riddle: Strength
passages.text:
The mallet you seek is not a toy for children,

It calls trouble like the song of a siren.

A test of strength the Monkey King will require,

Before you receive this tool of your desire.

At the Temple of the White Tiger you will find

A challenger to test how well you are resigned

Step through the main door and then turn right down the ramp

Challenge the ook waiting for you there like a champ!

passages.title: The Third Riddle: Strength
passages.text:
Why engage in duelery? Why engage in foolery?

You ask the Monkey King for an artifact of power, I have to make sure when the time comes you will not cower. One tough dooker you think you might ookin be, but against mogu, many will turn and flee.

passages.title: The Greatest Prank
passages.text:
So riddles three you answered me. Good good. The Monkey King is not so old that he tells just anyone his tricks.

It was the greatest prank ever!

You want to hear story of the Mallet and the Monkey? Too bad! No choice!

passages.title: The Greatest Prank
passages.text: What you think?

passages.title: The Greatest Prank
passages.text:
It looks like it is going to take us a few days to track all of these "minions" down.

Thank you for your help, <name>. Meet me in Lion's Landing in a few days and we will embark to track down these objects.

passages.title: Rebuilding the Mallet (Tracker)
passages.text: Time for the fixing and then time for the mixing!

passages.title: Plunder the Black Temple
passages.text: While Akama and his men are dealing with the demons, there is nobody to stop you from stealing a relic or two...

passages.title: Plunder the Black Temple
passages.text: You've looted everything you could grab on your way up. Time to tally up your plunder and hide it before Akama catches up...

passages.title: The Spirit Trap
passages.text:
Within the ruins we have identified several powerful mogu artifacts. They trapped spirits within, probably to use them in some ritual or conjuration.

They are a type of device that we haven't identified and desperately need to study - they may reveal more of the secrets of the mogu's spirit binding techniques. 

Go, find us a few samples so that we may continue a proper study.

passages.title: The Spirit Trap
passages.text: Have you brought the traps?

passages.title: The Spirit Trap
passages.text: Ahh, yes. Hmm. Hand that over. Carefully.

passages.title: We're Not Monsters!
passages.text:
The Reliquary may have had a bad name in the past, but we're not monsters. We simply hold different views about archaeology than the Explorers' League.

We do focus on performing acts of heroism from time to time. So go, liberate some of the pandaren slave spirits in the ruins.

passages.title: We're Not Monsters!
passages.text: Ah, good work. As much as it may seem trivial in comparison to our larger research goals, it is important that we maintain appearances, <name>.

passages.title: Oi Ain't Afraid o' No Ghosts!
passages.text:
Look. We got a nasty problem here, and ol' Troteman back at Lion's Landing's gonna throw us out of here if we don't get things under control.

Give us a hand, please!

passages.title: Oi Ain't Afraid o' No Ghosts!
passages.text: Alright! We'll be back up and runnin' in no time!

passages.title: Eviction Notice
passages.text:
The bloody Reliquary's snuck into the ruins. They've taken the lower section and are conducting all kinds of magical shenanigans down there.

It's time we gave 'em an eviction notice, in the form of your boot in their rear!

passages.title: Eviction Notice
passages.text: Did ye' deliver the message?

passages.title: Eviction Notice
passages.text: Ha! That should send 'em runnin' back to Silvermoon with their tail 'tween their legs!

passages.title: Kick 'em While They're Down
passages.text:
The Alliance may think they have a stranglehold on the ruins, given that their base of operations is close.

We're going to disabuse them of that notion. Go take out some of their guards.

passages.title: Kick 'em While They're Down
passages.text: Oh, what a fine day. Alliance fools defeated, and our research is moving ahead quite nicely.

passages.title: A Gathering Storm
passages.text:
If General Nazgrim sent you, then I trust you are capable of discretion.

When I arrived here, I found Garrosh... experimenting... with some ancient power that he found in the mountains to the north.

He believes that this "sha" can strengthen our soldiers.

Unfortunately, so far the results have been quite the opposite.

Our troops are erupting into random violence. Go and interrogate them. If they threaten you, be prepared to defend yourself.

passages.title: A Gathering Storm
passages.text: There is great power here... Why is it that so many fear it?

passages.title: A Gathering Storm
passages.text:
You bested my defenders? Finally, one who can control his hatred and violence!

I need more men like you.

passages.title: Tracking Event: Ambassadors Summoned
passages.text:
It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.

I'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

passages.title: Tracking Event: Event Complete
passages.text:
